description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s, after 80000 reasoning characters, or on a degenerate repetition pattern (exact repeat unit, sentence-template repeat, sparse repeat, or 6-gram density). On trip it injects a continue instruction that requires the next action to be a tool call, and ships 11 regression cases plus per-gate tuning.
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11 个回归用例与逐档调参。

description.en: Installs a dedicated AI novel-writing preset and workbench: revisioned local project assets, a compact side drawer, and native approval-gated single-file changes.
description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.
description.zh: 越用越聪明的 harness，告别金鱼记忆。每条 prompt 前，Evolver 从本地经验和 EvoMap 网络召回一条验证过的策略；回合结束后，它凭测试结果、改动是否被保留、你的下一句反馈给策略打分，再回报网络按证据加权。每一次成功都变成下一次的捷径，每一次失败都变成下一次的避坑指南。

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container, image, volume and secret management with approval-gated control.
description.zh: 让 agent 的 shell 与文件工具在一次性 Podman 容器中运行，默认只能访问工作区项目；同时提供容器、镜像、卷与机密管理，部分操作需审批。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Keyless web search that fuses eight engines, fetches page text through a proxy ladder, and adds eight vertical sources for packages, papers and questions.
description.zh: 免密钥的网页搜索：融合八个引擎、经代理梯队抓取正文，另有八个覆盖包、论文与问答的垂直来源。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: AI Quota & Usage Monitor for DSH: real-time balance and reset countdown tracking for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity, and OpenCode-Go.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：实时追踪 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity 与 OpenCode-Go 剩余额度与重置倒计时。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
description.zh: 白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session management, task notifications, skill controls, subagent model routing, and Linux permission maintenance.
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a persistent audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

description.en: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: Estimate session and turn costs with model prices in USD or CNY and price sync from models.dev, OpenRouter, or DeepInfra.
description.zh: 估算会话和每轮费用，按模型设置 USD 或 CNY 单价，并从 models.dev、OpenRouter 或 DeepInfra 同步价格。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏与浮层工作台中管理已有本地仓库，支持查看改动、提交、获取、拉取、推送以及浏览分支和历史。

description.en: OMC-style multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 omd-* skills and 12 /omd-* slash commands over the plan-execute-review-verify pipeline and team/autopilot/ralph modes.
description.zh: OMC 风格的多智能体编排层：29 个 omd-* skill + 12 条 /omd-* 命令，覆盖 plan-execute-review-verify 流水线与 team/autopilot/ralph 等模式。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
description.zh: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports custom models, skills, pause on failure, and permission settings.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.
description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转写、麦克风与系统音频录制、说话人标签及文本导出。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」，卡片随注册该 slot 的 kit 插件出现。

description.en: Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的日志查询卡片（Elasticsearch / OpenSearch）：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker 插件。agent 侧五个只读 loglens_* 工具（sources / search / fields / facets / context）与面板共用同一执行层。出站只打到已配置的来源，按解析后的 IP 判定，不跟随重定向，并有体积与超时上限。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with per-profile port configuration and a copyable launch command.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的终端面板：侧边栏「终端」打开多标签页 xterm.js 全交互终端（node-pty 真实 PTY），支持 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程标签页（agent/key/password 三种认证），cwd 跟随当前会话，并提供 tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send 三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.
description.zh: DSH Web 多品牌皮肤热切换：OpenBMC、UEFI 与《凡人修仙传》非官方同人画作三套皮肤，各带明暗双态配色，附个人壁纸图库、双语标语与通透度调节，随时一键回到官方界面。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.en: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.
description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

description.en: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.
description.zh: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

description.en: Gated multi-agent pipeline for OpenSpec changes — six opx_* tools drive the phase state machine, two agent presets (developer and reviewer) carry implementation and review, and 23 bundled skills define the quality standards they are checked against; full mode runs analyze, implement, then tool, task and dimension-based quality review, while simple mode runs implement and one merged quality review.
description.zh: 面向 OpenSpec 变更的按阶段门禁多 Agent 编排：6 个 opx_* 工具驱动阶段状态机，开发者与审核人两个 agent preset 分工实施与审查，23 份内置 skill 定义审查基准；完整流程为 analyze、实施、工具/任务/维度质量三层审查，精简流程为实施加一次合并质量审查。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off falls back to the backend defaults, default clears it), a Settings → Autocompact page manages the persisted per-model thresholds every session inherits, and a composer status entry shows the current reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按模型设置更早的自动压缩阈值：/autocompact 以精确 provider/model 为键写入仅本会话生效的覆盖值（off 回退后端默认、default 清除覆盖），设置页「自动压缩」管理所有会话继承的持久化逐模型阈值，输入框状态条目显示当前读数。

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 GitHub Copilot 通道补充网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Copilot 提供方路由，凭据存入内置凭据库，模型目录仅在首次登录兜底填充一次、永不覆盖已定制的模型条目。

description.en: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.
description.zh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users see only their own conversations, and unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt; personas can be defined and saved, with three Big fat fish personas included by default. A Big fat fish persona is active right after install.
description.zh: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它；可以自行定义/另存人格；默认带三个大肥鱼人格提示词；装好后默认启用大肥鱼人格。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.
description.zh: 编辑重发：在用户消息气泡上多一个「编辑」，改完从那条消息重新生成，图片与文件随行重传，模型继承原会话。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on a fixed interval, each run opening a fresh session, with a run history.
description.zh: 定时任务：按周期定时执行提示词，每次触发都开启全新会话，并保留运行记录。

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: DSH full liquid-glass skin: 13 adjustable refractive glass surfaces, time-of-day wallpapers, four theme colours, and a water-drop highlight on the selected item.
description.zh: DSH 全液态玻璃皮肤：13 个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in that project. Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里一站式管理技能与 MCP 服务器。技能以磁盘为准：浏览、搜索、预览正文、新建、重命名、删除，删除前自动写一份备份。全局 MCP 就是 cordis.patch.yml 里的真实 Loader 行，项目级条目只挂到对应项目的会话。展开卡片会列出该服务器实际注册的工具，并可只保留需要的那些——被挡下的工具不进工具注册表，因此不占用每一轮的上下文。每张卡片带连接状态标签（已连接并显示工具数 / 重试中 / 已放弃重试 / 激活失败）与一键重连，让启动时连不上、工具悄悄消失的服务器看得见。另可从 26 个 MCP 客户端导入既有配置。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic `rm`, download-and-run, git history rewrites) and for edits to credential paths or to files the turn never read, and hands the model the reason plus a working alternative.
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: Wraps the external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI in five model tools — one-shot review, whole-tree scan, deterministic scope/rule scaffolding and session lookup — and reports what OCR found separately from whether the run actually covered the selected files.
description.zh: 把外部 `ocr`（open-code-review）CLI 包成五个模型工具——单次评审、全树扫描、确定性的范围与规则脚手架、会话查询——并把「OCR 发现了什么」与「这次跑有没有覆盖完选中的文件」分成两套口径回报。

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm check`, `cargo check`, `ruff check .`, `tsc --noEmit`) and, only if that check really ran and failed, opens a new turn carrying the failure output instead of letting the turn close.
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
description.zh: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

description.en: Semantic workspace search: three model tools (`zg_search`, `zg_index`, `zg_status`) drive the `zg` CLI for hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF retrieval, with a search-first guard that makes `grep`/`rg` require a prior successful search in an indexed workspace.
description.zh: 工作区语义检索：三个模型工具（`zg_search` / `zg_index` / `zg_status`）驱动 `zg` CLI 做 BM25 + 向量 + RRF 混合检索，并带一层 search-first 守卫——已建索引的工作区里，`grep`/`rg` 需要先成功调用一次检索。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.
description.zh: 输入框提示词一键增强：模型选择器旁的按钮把草稿经一次辅助模型调用改写后直接写回输入框，输入框撤销不受影响；/prompt-enhance 命令把改写结果以命令结果行显示、不改动草稿；可在 profile 补丁里为增强调用单独固定 provider 和模型；改写忠实原文，保留意图、语言与信息量，代码、命令与路径原样保留，不编造事实、不输出占位文字。

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: Integrates coding agent CLIs, persistent terminals and remote workspaces into the native DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 将十几种编程助手 CLI、持久终端与远程工作区接入 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

description.en: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
description.zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

description.en: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.
description.zh: 撤回已发送的消息：会话日志只追加、不删除任何东西，被撤回的回合退出模型上下文并从对话界面消失、原文回到输入框，被这些回合改动的文件留在隔离区里——设置里独立一页，可查看可清理。

description.en: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline where every delivery must prove itself with structured evidence before the next phase may start; reviewers are read-only, code merges only after a review pass, and an append-only event log gives full replay and audit on a live kanban board. Its design draws inspiration from the Hermes Agent kanban.
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes Agent kanban。

description.en: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.
description.zh: 禅模式视图 + 前台盯屏时间统计插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简 Zen 标签页（进行中/结束状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 渲染最终回复、单行轮次统计），统计前台盯屏时长并给出每日/每周禅值，支持一键隐藏中间过程（工具调用/推理行）、任务开始完成时自动进出禅、Alt+Z 快捷键与 Zen 设置面板——纯前端实现，数据存 localStorage，无网络请求。

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

description.en: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

description.en: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.
description.zh: 心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

description.en: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.
description.zh: 虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.
description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

description.en: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.
description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

description.en: Read-only panel reporting an instance's plugin bundles, patch inserts, skills, upgrade health and decoupling health.
description.zh: 只读生态面板：汇总实例的插件束、补丁插入、技能、升级健康与解耦健康。

description.en: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.
description.zh: 自维护的 DSH 网页任务看板：带人工验收闸门、卡片类型与已执行卡片的可编辑备注。

description.en: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.
description.zh: 选中 DSH 已提交回复中的文字，开启独立、持久、只读的多轮 Topic；Topic 绑定来源会话证据与项目文件，来源 Agent 可继续运行。

description.en: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits, categories are created, renamed, reordered and deleted in place, and skills are dragged or picked between them. A first run can let the profile model build the first classification, or place skills into categories the user built first; clicking a row copies its /skill-name and hovering unfolds the description the skill ships.
description.zh: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开 skill 自带的描述。

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话提示词配置：可复用的系统提示词片段组成命名配置，并在会话启动时固化进该会话的提示词。

description.en: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 KnyazevAI API 提供方及 DeepSeek、GLM 和 MiniMax 模型目录。

description.en: Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

description.en: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.
description.zh: 当前工作区的只读 Git 面板：分支、改动清单、差异与图片前后对比，外加输入框上方的三枚胶囊（Git 状态、工具与技能活动、会话运行时长），以及本会话改动归因与审阅进度。

description.en: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.
description.zh: 给会话里的每条消息加上「撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后」悬浮按钮：以 append-only 墓碑让内容同时从模型上下文与对话界面消失，带空内容兜底，旧删除不会打回严格校验的 provider。已实测支持 DSH 2.0 桌面版。

description.en: Automatically disables a failing plugin so the rest of DSH keeps booting — by patching DSH’s own installed kernel (mount-time quarantine + self-healing), not preflight smoke-tests. Includes status tools and a one-click restore panel.
description.zh: 自动隔离损坏插件、让 DSH 其余插件照常启动——通过补丁 DSH 自身已安装的内核实现（挂载期隔离 + 补丁自愈），而非 preflight 冒烟测试。附带状态工具与一键恢复面板。

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.
description.zh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

description.en: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API Key；输出语言跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英）。

description.en: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.
description.zh: DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用 memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin 管理。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置好的模型通过 OpenAI 兼容网关中转出去，其他本地项目 用标准 OpenAI 客户端即可调用。多个供应商候选共享一个具名分组，支持顺序、均衡、 随机三种调度；上游在产出任何内容前失败时自动切换下一候选，客户端无感，被限流的 请求按供应商指示的退避时间自动重试。每条候选的调用统计（尝试、应答、失败、 token/TTFT 累计）以徽章形式显示在设置页，按天聚合的数据落盘为本地文件，附 30 天 热力图与趋势视图。在界面创建密钥之前，接口对任何能访问到它的人开放；创建密钥 （仅存 SHA-256 哈希）后开启校验，且删掉最后一个密钥仍保持锁定，需显式关闭鉴权 才会重新开放。若启用可选的局域网监听而未配密钥，该端口对整个局域网开放。支持 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 至 0.1.7-alpha.1 及以后。

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and current-session spend estimate in a top-bar chip and settings card, with pause-aware auto-refresh, an editable official price table, a `deepseek_balance` model tool, and a bilingual UI.
description.zh: 顶栏徽章与设置卡片展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话预估花费：暂停感知的自动刷新、可编辑官方价格表、`deepseek_balance` 模型工具与中英文界面。

description.en: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
description.zh: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with isolated memory, WeChat channels, Skills, schedules, heartbeat concerns, and a dependency-aware task board.
description.zh: 提供隔离记忆、微信渠道、Skill、定时任务、伙伴挂念与依赖任务看板的长期 AI 伙伴。

description.en: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 配置、浏览器终端、SFTP 浏览、端口转发、代理与会话级 AI 访问。

description.en: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter.
description.zh: 双模型 Auto 路由插件：低成本模型直返 / 高成本模型升级 + 逃逸学习闭环（直返答错自动学习指纹，同指纹下次强制升级），状态持久化并与 Python ModelRouter 互通。

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Tauri 2 桌面应用：检测或自动安装全局 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包，启动 DSH Web 并嵌入自身窗口，支持系统托盘管理、登录自启、全局快捷键与桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.
description.zh: 提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination, and conversation management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。

description.en: Encrypted, chunked full backups of a DSH installation: config, sessions, plugins, workspaces and Hindsight memory packed into AES-256-GCM volumes that unlock by passphrase, recovery code or this machine's DPAPI slot, each package carrying a self-contained restorer, GFS rotation (last, daily, weekly, monthly, plus a total size cap and a recycle bin) and network or WebDAV targets. Zero external dependencies — node: builtins only, no 7z, openssl or rclone.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的配置、会话、插件、工作区与 Hindsight 记忆加密分卷打包：AES-256-GCM 卷可用口令、恢复码或本机 DPAPI 免密槽解开，包内自带自包含还原器；GFS 四档滚动保留（最近 / 每日 / 每周 / 每月，另有总体积上限与回收站），支持网络路径与 WebDAV 目标。零外部依赖，只用 node: 内置模块，不需要 7z、openssl 或 rclone。

description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.
description.zh: 输入框上方提供 Git 分支选择器，并把分支泳道与提交历史画成图谱，沿着时间线找到任意变更。

description.en: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用、创建新技能、删除进可恢复回收站。

description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.
description.zh: 侧边栏多列任务看板：卡片交给真实 DSH 智能体会话执行，支持 cron 定时（Host 侧到点执行，关浏览器也生效）。

description.en: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.
description.zh: 常驻界面的鲸鱼娘：随智能体状态切换动画，可摸头互动、喂小鱼干养亲密度，从幼鲸一路养成。

description.en: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.
description.zh: 手机/PC 远程操控 dsh web 工作区：扫码配对、令牌门控通道、SSE 实时同步，提供移动端与完整桌面 GUI 两种远程形态。

description.en: SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.
description.zh: SSH 远程运维面板：Web 终端、SFTP 传输、本地端口转发与一条命令并发集群执行，Agent 与面板共用同一份主机配置。

description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。

description.en: Local Git plus the four GitHub remote tabs in the official DSH right sidebar: Changes (per-file staging, line diffs, and commit messages written by the model already configured in DSH), History, then Code, Issues, Pull requests and Actions proxied by the host half. The token stays in the host half through ctx.credentials and /dsh-git/* accepts loopback requests only.
description.zh: DSH 官方右侧栏里的本地 Git 与四个 GitHub 远端页签：Changes（按文件暂存、逐行 diff、提交信息由 DSH 里已配好的模型生成）、History，以及由 host 半代理的 Code / Issues / Pull requests / Actions。令牌只存在 host 半（ctx.credentials），/dsh-git/* 只接受 loopback 请求。

description.en: Global token totals across every local DSH conversation, de-duplicated by message id, with custom date ranges and per-provider monthly quota tracking.
description.zh: 统计本机全部 DSH 会话的历史 token 消耗，按 message.id 去重，支持自定义日期区间与按接入方的月度额度剩余。

description.en: Quantitative data quality scoring based on GB/T 36344-2018, providing auditable quality reports for data asset capitalization.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.
description.zh: 数据血缘追踪工具，梳理数据从产生到流转的全链路，满足数据产权登记中的来源合法性审查要求。

description.en: Automated data masking tool based on national standards, automatically identifying sensitive fields like ID cards and phone numbers.
description.zh: 基于国家标准的自动化数据脱敏工具，自动识别身份证、手机号等敏感字段，支持完全匿名化与假名化分级策略，生成合规审计日志。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.
description.zh: 从界面删除会话（会话头部按钮或侧栏行菜单），或由 agent 调用 session_delete 工具：先停止并释放运行中的 Agent 与会话，再清理日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账，级联删除它拥有的子代理会话（分叉分支不受影响）。

description.en: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.
description.zh: 通过 Window Controls Overlay 让已安装的 dsh Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏——清单路由带 display_override 返回，应用自身的侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 成为拖拽区，应用自身右侧控件自动让开浏览器标题栏 chrome。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。

description.en: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

description.en: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
description.zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

description.en: CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。

description.en: Copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box copy while the real disk stays untouched (Windows only, requires Sandboxie-Plus).
description.zh: 写时复制权限预设：shell 命令在工作区专属的 Sandboxie 沙盒内运行，工作区外的写入落进沙盒副本、真实磁盘不受影响（仅 Windows，需先安装 Sandboxie-Plus）。

description.en: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.
description.zh: 将会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期事件转换为 OpenTelemetry GenAI 调用链与指标，通过标准 OTLP/HTTP 导出到任意兼容后端，正文采集默认关闭。

description.en: Codebase Memory MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: six knowledge-graph code tools, auto-started background daemon with visualization Web UI, and bundled agent skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codebase Memory MCP 桥接插件：提供六个原生代码知识图谱工具、自动启动后台守护进程及可视化 Web 界面，并内置专属代理技能。

description.en: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的工程智能——为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、证据感知、项目隔离的工程记忆，以及统一的混合搜索（记忆 + RAG 文档）。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.
description.zh: 安装后自动将 DSH 网页搜索路由到本插件；只需配置服务商、API Key 和模型即可使用。支持 DeepSeek 原生搜索与 OpenAI 兼容自定义后端，已发布为 npm 包 @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3。

description.en: Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读图与生图/编辑能力（Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini 读图，Qwen-Image 生图与编辑）。基于 liustack/modlens（MIT）改造；请先卸载 @liustack/modlens——两者会注册同一批 vision provider 与图片拦截钩子，并存会导致读图失灵。

description.en: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.
description.zh: 为任务事件提供 Windows 桌面通知、可选提示音和 DSH 风格的页面通知。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
