description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that strips heavy orchestration for fast, direct tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简 Agent 预设插件：移除沉重编排机制与冗余组件，直达核心工具循环，响应迅速。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包（27 个文件名 + 7 个私钥后缀的黑名单，外加内容特征闸，导入侧再过一遍），每次导入前先写一份可原样还原的快照；归档可以推到任意 WebDAV 服务（绿联 NAS / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud）并在新机器上下载回来。另含定时备份、单文件只读查看、面板内的云端卡片；零 npm 运行时依赖（打包用系统 tar）。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.
description.zh: 余额看板，可以添加多个按量计费/Token plan，同时查询余额。

description.en: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.
description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与 system/tools/messages 的估算构成。面板只读：不估算费用、不修改会话、不触发 compaction。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: Takes tasks from Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client (through the dsh-baton-mcp server) over an owner-only local socket: creates or continues a specific Harness session, runs it live in the UI labelled with the sender, and hands the result back when the turn ends. 12 MCP tools cover workspaces, sessions and runs.
description.zh: 通过本机仅限当前用户的 socket，接收 Claude Code、Codex 或任意 MCP 客户端（经 dsh-baton-mcp）交来的任务：新建或继续指定的 Harness 会话，在界面里实时运行并标注发送方，回合结束后把结果交回。12 个 MCP 工具覆盖工作区、会话和运行。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off levels, and optional always-on ruleset injection via config. Vendored verbatim from upstream ponytail (MIT), zero tools registered, clean uninstall.
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.
description.zh: 替代官方「模型」设置页：提供方生命周期管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖动排序与上游模型同步。

description.en: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh: 为第三方供应商模型按模型配置思考强度与输入模态：知识库与原始 /models 端点取证融合建议并标注置信度，在官方「模型」页卡片内直接编辑。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。

description.en: A whale-maid with a jar, sitting in the corner of your DSH window. She goes exploring on Bilibili for whatever you are into, ranks by like, coin and favourite rate rather than view count, and brings back pickled snacks that suit your taste. When a term runs dry she takes another route. Five picks go into the jar, and she tells you what each video is about. News-type axes keep only the last two weeks; game guides and music have no limit, and each axis decides for itself.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘带着一个罐子，守在右下角。按照你的兴趣，她会去 B 站探险，按赞币藏率排，给你找一些符合口味的电子榨菜。哪个词搜得少，她换条路再找。回来把五条装进罐子里，然后和你说说这些视频讲了什么。时政这类她只留最近两周，游戏攻略和音乐不限时间，每根轴她自己定。

description.en: Let the Blue Big Fat Fish browse Bilibili for you: it comments on your behalf, DMs you interesting finds, writes a diary, and keeps a memory for long-term summaries. It filters videos to your taste, creates Markdown digests, and can watch comments and reply for you. In Circle Mode, it replies only inside threads explicitly invited by the video uploader in a top-level comment — ordinary viewer requests do not count, and it never starts a new top-level comment. Commenting, DMs, auto-run, and comment watch are off by default. Needs Node 22, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+, a signed-in Bilibili account, a model route and Python.
description.zh: 让蓝色大肥鱼替你刷 B 站：帮你评论，把发现的有趣内容私信给你，还会写下日记；它也有记忆，能长期总结。视频按你的口味筛选并生成 Markdown 日报，也能守着评论区替你回话。开启「圈地自萌」后，它只回视频 UP 主本人主动邀请的楼中楼，普通观众喊话不算，绝不自己起新楼；评论、私信、自动运行和守护默认关闭。需 Node 22、DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+、已登录的 B 站账号、模型线路与 Python。

description.en: Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑内容、写日报，遇到值得看的会发评论 @ 你。

description.en: Reads Bilibili video content as text for DSH agents: metadata, subtitles, ASR, frame OCR, comments and danmaku. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; the ASR/OCR venvs need Python 3.10+; AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频内容读成文本：元数据、字幕、本地转写、抽帧 OCR、评论与弹幕。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；ASR/OCR 虚拟环境需 Python 3.10+；AI 字幕需登录 Bilibili。

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

description.en: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

description.en: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a skill_library tool, per-message skill selection and a time/step convergence guard.
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
description.zh: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

description.en: Model-directed context compaction for PTC mode, grouping program runs into blocks and replacing completed block messages with model-written summaries.
description.zh: 为 PTC 模式提供模型自主收口的动态上下文压缩，将程序执行归入区块，并用模型撰写的摘要替换已完成区块的消息。

description.en: Bloom Morandi theme: ten variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all 20 foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，20 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

description.en: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval or answer, and who failed, with a hand-off table grouped by sender, a per-Bot drawer showing the pending command or question, and a collapsed one-line pill. Read-only — it never writes to DS Bot's data. Needs the DS Bot plugin installed (built against 0.1.7 and 0.2.0); the panel stays hidden without it.
description.zh: DS Bot 团队的一块浮动看板：谁在跑、在跑什么工具，谁在等别的 Bot 交活，谁在等你批或等你答，谁报错了；带按发送方分组的交接表、显示待批命令或待答问题的单个 Bot 抽屉，收起后是一条状态胶囊。只读，不写 DS Bot 的数据。需要先装 DS Bot（按 0.1.7 与 0.2.0 开发）；没有 DS Bot 时面板不显示。

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer ships demo data and needs no Python; rebuilding the graph from your own notes needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ and runs from the command line.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 笔记编译成脑形关系图谱的 DSH 侧栏查看器，附带文档导入与图谱构建管线。查看器自带演示数据、无需 Python；用自己的笔记重建图谱需要 Node.js 20+ 与 Python 3.8+，在命令行里运行。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick, upstream-gone, or PR-merged — and deletes them when asked. It only reports by default, never switches branches or rebases, and backs every deleted local branch up under refs/backup/branch-cleaner/ (deleting remote branches has no backup).
description.zh: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份）。

description.en: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.
description.zh: DSH 共享网页界面的自定义品牌：在「设置 → 品牌」中修改名称、徽章，选择本地 logo 和字标图片并调整大小与圆角、实时预览、可选自定义页面标题、一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Makes 1080x1920 vertical promo videos from a storyboard JSON with 7 tools (doctor, setup, catalog, guide, validate, render, verify), rendered locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 从分镜 JSON 生成 1080×1920 竖版宣传片，含 7 个工具（doctor、setup、catalog、guide、validate、render、verify），用 Remotion 本地渲染。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入）：30+ bcdp_* 工具，实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；DSH 0.1.5/0.1.7/0.2.0 宿主各有一条对应版本线。

description.en: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.
description.zh: dsh 浏览器扩展的桌面端一半：在 dsh 自带的 webserver 上挂一个带令牌校验的 WebSocket 桥，向模型暴露 browser_* 工具，让它读取并操作用户当前标签页，图片识别默认关闭、需用户自行开启。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
description.zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个 Playwright 工具（20 个常驻、3 个默认关闭的强力工具），URL 白名单、弹窗挂起、CDP 方法白名单都是机制级且有测试钉住。

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
description.zh: 安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

description.en: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.
description.zh: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，工具执行与审批仍由 DSH 负责，附按模型切换的额度药丸和设置页；需 Node 22.19+ 并登录 Antigravity 账号。

description.en: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
description.zh: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

description.en: Editable quick-action buttons beside the DSH composer: send preset text or insert it into the draft, then reorder, move, or resize the buttons. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑快捷按钮：发送预设文字，或只填入草稿；可排序、换位置、调大小。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不覆盖。

description.en: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing working-hour peak/off-peak pricing, per-model rates, and third-party relays billed too.
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DSH.
description.zh: 展示缓存命中、发送前确认请求前缀风险，并按调用步骤定位缓存失效。

description.en: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.
description.zh: 通过 cad_view/cad_info 与 OCCT 参数化建模工具查看和构建 CAD 模型（STL、OBJ、STEP、IGES、DXF、SVG），并在 Web UI 中提供交互式查看卡片与常驻 CAD 面板。

description.en: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
description.zh: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel inside the settings page, in-panel connection setup that is tested before saving, and drag-to-reschedule in the week view (15-minute snapping, undo). A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
description.zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
description.zh: 一站式管理 MCP 服务器、技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。

description.en: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching; the whole UI is tinted from the palette and hover interactions glow in the theme accent.
description.zh: 🐱 Catppuccin 主题插件：充满活力、令人放松的柔和彩色主题。遵循官方 26 色粉彩盘，🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha 四档一键切换，全界面按色盘上色，鼠标滑过交互变主题色。

description.en: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/ plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via a memory-IR parse layer that keeps .claude as the source of truth with no writes back. Six installable packages: loader, skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp.
description.zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，零回写。六个可安装包：loader、skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

description.en: Animated background themes for the DSH desktop — 10 scene renderers (milky way, glow horizon, layered mountains, cloud dome, aurora ionosphere, black hole, cloud train, particle image, pixel sculpt, blinking squares), a wallpaper and video library, per-zone UI surface transparency, and a replica of the Appearance settings panel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版换上动态背景——10 种场景渲染器（银河、辉光地平线、层峦、云穹、极光电离层、黑洞、云列车、粒子成像、像素雕塑、闪烁方块）、壁纸与视频素材库、UI 表面分区透明，外加逐像素复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。

description.en: In-session cd for DeepSeek Harness: re-base relative paths on the fly (the file tools and the bash/pwsh default workdir follow) or move the session to another workspace for real — a `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` call the user has agreed to, or the user's own `/cd <directory>` command, relocates the session's stored log, sandbox root, AGENTS.md and skill discovery and sidebar grouping. Per-session, persisted across restarts, without moving the session for a plain re-base.
description.zh: 会话内 cd：即时切换相对路径基准（文件工具与 bash / pwsh 默认工作目录跟随），或把会话真正搬到另一个工作区——经用户同意的 `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` 或用户自己的 `/cd <目录>` 命令，会迁移会话日志存储位置、沙箱根、AGENTS.md 与 skills 发现根以及侧边栏分组；按会话隔离、跨重启恢复，单纯换基准时不动会话身份。

description.en: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

description.en: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
description.zh: 侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。

description.en: WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness: QR-code login, two-way text, image and file messaging, slash commands in WeChat including /cwd and /skills, approval and question cards answered from the chat, and reply sending that splits over-long answers and backs off on rate limits instead of dropping them. Only the account that scanned the login is admitted by default; messages from anyone else are ignored.
description.zh: 把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的通道插件：扫码登录，双向收发文本、图片与文件，微信内可用 /cwd、/skills 等命令，审批卡与提问卡在聊天里回答；回复侧会切分超长正文、对限流退避重试，而不是直接丢弃。默认只放行扫码登录的那个微信号，其他人发来的消息一律忽略。

description.en: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

description.en: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
description.zh: 在每轮 AI 回复左侧与你的每条输入右侧各显示一个头像，可上传自己的图片并设置尺寸与圆形/方形头像框。

description.en: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak table. Every finished answer carries its own price in the transcript, and a chat that is not currently open is priced from the log instead of disappearing. Spend is costed per interval from an append-only JSONL ledger in the project folder, so logged work keeps the tariff it was billed at. On top of it: budget-aware work plans packed against a money limit, routing scenarios that show which models are worth connecting, a generated plan document in English, Chinese or Russian, and a warning when spend belongs to no plan unit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的每个对话实时计算 token 费用：本对话、其子代理与整棵会话树，价格来自内置的 models.dev 快照：七家供应商、139 个有价模型，缓存读写费率按供应商实际公布的取值，DeepSeek 则使用其官方峰谷价格表。每个完成的回答都会在对话中显示自身费用，未打开的对话则按日志计价而不是整行消失。费用按区间计价，依据写入项目目录的只追加 JSONL 账本，因此已记录的工作保留当时的费率。此外还提供：按金额预算排布的工作计划、展示值得接入哪些模型的路由方案比较、以英语/中文/俄语生成的计划文档，以及当费用未归入任何计划单元时的提醒。

description.en: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, open them with another registered application, and copy paths or links. Every candidate path is verified by the Host filesystem before an open action appears.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加右键菜单：复制选中内容或整条消息；把消息图片和点击预览后的大图复制为 PNG 到剪贴板或另存为文件；识别绝对路径、相对会话工作区的路径、~/ 以及代码内联路径，一键打开、 在文件管理器中显示、用其他应用打开、复制绝对/相对路径；链接可打开或复制。所有候选路径都会 先由 Host 文件系统校验存在性，再显示打开项。

description.en: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
description.zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

description.en: Full-screen lightbox for chat images: click any image to open the full-resolution original with zoom (wheel, buttons, shortcuts), drag panning, prev/next paging, filename caption and download, plus keyboard-arrow and touch-swipe navigation. One "image display control" popover next to the composer collapses every image in the conversation into a thumbnail grid whose column count (1-12) is configurable and remembered, or hides them entirely so the space closes up and restores them later; images are styled in place and no node is ever moved or reparented. The host-side display_image tool takes a local path or directory (TIFF/HEIC transcoded, originals still saved on download), a remote URL, or a keyword search over Bing, Huaban and Sogou that samples loadability before picking a source, re-saves images blocked by hotlink protection and drops dead links after a magic-byte check, returning paste-ready Markdown. It also keeps a system-prompt rule that every delivered image must appear in the reply body as ![](…) markdown, because collapsed tool rows are invisible to the reader.
description.zh: 聊天图片全屏查看器：点击任意图片打开原始分辨率大图，支持缩放（滚轮、按钮、快捷键）、拖拽平移、左右翻页、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换。输入框旁一个「对话图显控制」面板，可一键把整个会话的图收成可调列数（1–12，自动记忆）的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏并收掉占位、随时还原；图片只原地加样式，绝不搬移或重挂节点。宿主侧 display_image 工具支持本地路径或目录（TIFF/HEIC 自动转码，下载仍保存原文件）、网络直链、以及 Bing、花瓣、搜狗的关键词搜图（按抽样可加载率选源，被防盗链拦截的自动转存，坏链按字节校验剔除），返回可直接粘贴的 Markdown；并在 system prompt 常驻一条投递规则，要求发出的图必须写进回复正文（![](…)），因为折叠的工具行读者看不到。

description.en: Automatically generates and displays images in the DSH chat via API channels or local CLIs (mmx / codex / agy), and can also recognize images using the corresponding CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天窗口自动调用生图工具（API 渠道，或本机 CLI：已支持 mmx / codex / agy）并展示图片，也支持利用对应 CLI 识别图片。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话提问索引：右缘时间比例圆点窄条与可展开链面板，展示每次用户提问的问题与时间，含分支/子会话；点击节点跳转并高亮对应消息。

description.en: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
description.zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

description.en: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.
description.zh: DSH 对话定位条的轮次轨道设置：刻度粗细、轨道在左还是在右、锚在悬停那根的曲线长度渐变，以及行数、字号、宽度都可调的纯文本悬停预览。

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
description.zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，关键词过滤与一键跳转，轻便/全面两种历史模式，按住 Ctrl/Shift 单击可跳到轨迹视图同一位置。

description.en: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 已完成的助手回复增加编辑入口，可改写正文或思维链，改动以 surface replacement 形式保存。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
description.zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

description.en: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.
description.zh: 对话大纲目录导航：支持书签标记、轮次置顶钉住、全局快捷键与智能标题提取。

description.en: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.
description.zh: 把一个对话的所有分支画成聊天区旁边的一棵可点击的树，支持收藏、自定义图标与颜色、分支合并与拆分、撤回感知的布局，以及带记忆的 Claude Code 分支。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的模型设置中使用浏览器或设备码登录 ChatGPT 账号，并直接查看 Codex 订阅用量。

description.en: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
description.zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

description.en: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.
description.zh: 会话级清单：每个会话一棵任务树、按预算注入提示词的摘要，以及可改条目标题的右侧栏面板。

description.en: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
description.zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools for agents/sessions/history/interactions, and a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话桥接到局域网内的 Cherry Studio 桌面端——二维码配对、14 个 cherry_* 工具（agent/会话/历史/交互）与设置页（设备管理、按工作区的工具启用范围）。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.
description.zh: 免 token 诗词查询插件，在会话页头新增「诗词」标签页，支持搜索、筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏、简繁、节日专题与分享卡片图；AI 解读复用 DSH 会话。

description.en: Type /私 and complete 私家大厨 — Chinese skill names, zero renaming. Patches DSH skill discovery, the / gesture and the skill tool so any Unicode SKILL.md name (私家大厨, 卡路里, 作息管家…) works: slash completion, direct /私家大厨 invocation, model skill({name}) loading. Zero config; runtime changes revert on uninstall, but the regex patch written into three DSH packages on disk stays until the next DSH upgrade replaces those files.
description.zh: 中文技能名零改造直用：输入 /私 自动补全 私家大厨。为 DSH 打上技能发现、斜杠手势与 skill 工具补丁，Unicode 技能名（私家大厨/卡路里/作息管家…）补全、直达、加载全可用；不改 SKILL.md、零配置；运行时改动随卸载恢复，但写进 DSH 三个依赖包磁盘文件里的正则补丁会保留到下次 DSH 升级覆盖为止。

description.en: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏内嵌 dsh 网页界面，让 agent 读取当前页面、捕获 HTTP 流量并操作浏览器。

description.en: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages and takes screenshots in your real tabs. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 11 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows the registration goes into the registry (for Chrome and Edge) and the host talks over a named pipe. A daily CI run on GitHub's macOS, Windows and Linux machines installs the plugin, loads the extension into a real Chrome and reads a page through the browser_* tools.
description.zh: 操作你已经登录的 Chrome：模型在你真实的标签页里点击、打字、填表、读网页、截图。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux；需要 Chrome 116+ 与 Node 18+。走 native messaging 与 chrome.debugger，不开监听端口。提供 11 个 browser_* 原生工具和一个 cb 命令行，发送真实 CDP 输入事件，绘制会出现在截图里的页内光标，并带一个工具栏面板（连接状态、正在控制的标签页、暂停开关）。宿主（原生宿主 + MV3 扩展）随本 tarball 一起发：插件首次加载时自己把它们落盘并写好 native messaging 注册，不用 clone 仓库、不用 install.sh、不用 python3——只剩把扩展装进 Chrome：从 Chrome 应用商店装 DSH Bridge（https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo，不用开发者模式），或者到 chrome://extensions 加载自带的已解压扩展（插件会替你打开那个页面并把文件夹放进剪贴板）。没装好之前，工具会带着这几步明确报错。Windows 上注册写进注册表（Chrome 和 Edge 都写），宿主走命名管道。每天在 GitHub 的 macOS / Windows / Linux 机器上自动跑一遍：装插件、把扩展加载进真 Chrome、用 browser_* 工具读一个网页。

description.en: Finds wasted GitHub Actions runner time and proposes small, reviewable workflow patches, with explicit approval before any edit and a DSH settings page for analysis rules, history limits, storage, and cost estimation.
description.zh: 找出被浪费的 GitHub Actions 运行时间，并提出小而可审查的工作流补丁；任何修改都需要明确批准，并提供用于分析规则、历史上限、存储和成本估算的 DSH 设置页面。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/SessionEnd）、 .mcp.json 服务器，并支持 Claude Code 插件 marketplace。自带 /cc-plugin 插件与市场全管理（claude CLI 优先、自实现兜底）、/cc-resume 列出并把 Claude Code 会话导入为 DSH 原生事件日志、/cc-export 把 DSH skill 导出为 Claude Code skill。Claude Code 与 DSH 的双向桥。

description.en: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，提供紧凑侧栏与会话布局、浅色与深色主题、模型与推理强度控件，以及支持随机喷水、轻弹和摆尾互动的新会话页像素小鲸鱼。

description.en: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 只读桥接 Claude Code 已有项目记忆到 DSH：按 git 仓库根解析、注入前脱敏、按需检索工具，零依赖。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.
description.zh: 把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
description.zh: 把推理强度下拉菜单换成可拖拽吸附的滑块，并提供 13 款 Canvas 动效，分属推进、流体、幻境、科技、质感五个家族；动效随推理档位分三阶递进解锁。客制动效可自由组合 10 种粒子形态与 8 种流动轨迹；9 款预设主题色与 Hex 拾色器让全部动效跟随变色，档位吸附音效支持两段语音、合成鸭子叫、机械微触感与本地音频文件。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。

description.en: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.
description.zh: DSH 纯净桌面壳：双击桌面快捷方式即可像普通桌面软件一样启动；后端活性实时监测 + 托盘一键启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、单实例。复用现有 web profile，不改动 web 界面。Windows + macOS 双平台。

description.en: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
description.zh: 让模型自主压缩自身上下文的 dsh 插件：mind_map 工具俯瞰模型自己的上下文表面（稳定 seq、角色、token 重量、清理边界标记，返回内附清理手册），clear_mind 工具把选定的对话历史区间替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 渲染可展开的压缩行），调用对自动折叠成单行墓碑，上下文过长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理；人类侧会话记录保持原样、可审计可回退。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
description.zh: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

description.en: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
description.zh: 模型选择器旁的 CLIProxyAPI 额度圆环，设置面板仿 CPA 管理页列出全部账号的额度窗口、套餐与刷新时间。

description.en: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Dracula（VS Code 吸血鬼）深色主题：把产品自身的配色令牌映射到德古拉调色板，并附更紧的字号阶梯、1080px 正文列宽与不折行的代码块。仅深色模式。

description.en: Notes and folder reader in the main panel: a file tree with pinned files, closeable tabs, Markdown split edit/preview with synced scrolling, plain-text editing, manual save, and drag-to-move. Deleting a file moves it to the system trash where one exists (macOS, Linux), falling back to an in-folder dsh-notes-trash directory; Windows has no delete entry.
description.zh: 主面板内的笔记与目录阅读器：文件树与置顶、可关闭的标签页、Markdown 左编右渲与同步滚动、纯文本编辑、手动保存、拖拽移动文件。删除时移入系统回收站（macOS、Linux），系统回收站不可用时移入目录内的 dsh-notes-trash 目录；Windows 不提供删除入口。

description.en: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
description.zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

description.en: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤：月光冥界森林，青绿流云缓缓翻涌、绯红彼岸花自左下蔓延、角落里趴着一只睡猫，底层是 WebGL2 流体；另有自定义壁纸与视频背景。内置两套可一键切换的风格（淡雅 / 蓝色），并有猫爪、小鱼、泡泡、星光装饰。一个开关即可完全还原原生界面。

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation, a file preview or the terminal to quote it: the floating bar offers Comment, Add to chat and Side chat, and Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B do the same three things. The quote - and its comment, kept in the same chip - is inserted as a native reference chip, and a sent quote stays one rounded capsule in the message that expands on click and can be copied. A hover card can jump back to the message a quote came from, and the right sidebar carries a quote list page that searches every quote of the session, jumps back to any of them and exports them as Markdown. Side chat writes the quote into the composer of one dsh-better-sidebar side thread per conversation without sending it, and that page can bring the thread conclusion back into the main composer or export it as a file. A sent quote can also be revised: the card puts its old comment back in the comment box, the corrected quote is sent as a new message, and the old capsule is marked as superseded (the transcript itself is append-only).
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话、文件预览或终端里选中文字即可引用：浮层提供「评论」「添加到对话」与「侧边对话」，Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B 是同样的三个动作。引用以原生 reference-chip 插入输入框，评论与引用在同一颗芯片里；发送后消息里仍是一颗圆角胶囊，可点击展开、可复制，悬停卡片可「跳回原文」。右侧栏还有一个引用清单页：搜索本会话全部引用、跳回原文、导出 Markdown，底部可把侧边线程的结论带回主会话输入框或导出成文件。已发送的引用还能「改这条引用」：卡片把旧评论放回评论框，改好发出一条新引用，旧胶囊随即标「已修订」（DSH 的消息本身只追加，改不了原消息）。「侧边对话」把引用写进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边线程的输入框（一条主会话一条线程），不替你发送。

description.en: Seaglass is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme.
description.zh: Seaglass是一个高自由度的玻璃质感主题。

description.en: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把每天和各种 AI 的对话提炼成结构化 Markdown 笔记，写入你的 Obsidian 库。

description.en: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

description.en: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.
description.zh: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

description.en: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
description.zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

description.en: Connects one or more CLIProxyAPI (CPA) servers to DeepSeek Harness, discovers each server's models and syncs the selected ones into the model picker, routing each model over its native protocol (Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses or OpenAI Chat) with per-model parameter overrides; with a CPA management key it shows per-credential upstream quota in a settings tab and as a badge beside the model picker, and it checks for its own updates and installs them through dshmarket when that is present.
description.zh: 把一个或多个 CLIProxyAPI（CPA）服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，发现各服务的模型并把勾选的模型同步到模型选择器，每个模型按原生协议（Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses 或 OpenAI Chat）请求，并支持单模型参数覆盖；填写 CPA 管理密钥后，可在设置页的额度标签和模型选择器旁的徽标查看各凭证的上游额度；还能检查插件自身更新，装有 dshmarket 时通过它安装。

description.en: Multi-CLI worker sidebar for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with task dispatch, live conversation views, stop and follow-up controls, and custom role presets.
description.zh: 适用于 macOS / Windows 和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件，提供任务派遣、实时对话查看、停止与续聊及自定义角色预设。

description.en: Re-validates Cloudflare Access JWTs at the DSH origin so Settings, Credentials, Agent Preset management, and model discovery work from a remote hostname.
description.zh: 在 DSH Origin 校验 Cloudflare Access JWT，使 Settings、凭据、Agent Preset 管理与模型发现可在远程主机名下使用。

description.en: Cloudflare Workers AI media tools for dsh - text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Per-model price badges, a native settings card, reuse of an existing Cloudflare account, and output files named after the model that made them.
description.zh: 把 Cloudflare Workers AI 的多媒体模型接进 dsh：生图、TTS、语音转写都有；每个模型标注价格档位，带原生设置页，复用已有的 Cloudflare 账号，输出文件带模型名。

description.en: Tencent CloudQ integration: AIOps chat mode with usage, inspiration, artifact and architecture panels.
description.zh: 腾讯云智能顾问集成：CloudQ 对话模式，附用量、灵感、制品与架构图面板。

description.en: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).
description.zh: 会话代码收集器：输入框右侧按钮一键汇总当前会话中模型产出的全部代码块，支持按语言/按文件双视图、同一文件的版本历史、实时搜索过滤、单条/全部复制、下载合并 Markdown，点击直接跳转到产出该代码的回合（Alt+Shift+C 快捷开关）。

description.en: Parses DSH session logs to attribute AI-written files, overlays c8 coverage, and reports AI vs human code coverage with a trust score, plus a check/fix/verify tool loop for closing test gaps.
description.zh: 解析 DSH session 日志归因 AI 生成文件，叠加 c8 覆盖率，产出「AI vs 人工代码」覆盖率对比与信任分，并提供 check/fix/verify 三工具闭环补齐测试盲区。

description.en: Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.
description.zh: DSH 本地代码智能插件：Impact X-Ray 可视化展示潜在变更影响、源码证据与不确定性，并提供符号导航、有界 Context Pack 和 ArkTS 支持。

description.en: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.
description.zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。

description.en: Persistent C/C++, Python, and TypeScript definition navigation with a standalone workspace UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 C/C++、Python 和 TypeScript 定义跳转及独立工作区界面。

description.en: Renders inline code in DSH chat as pills with syntax colours and optional file badges, styles chat file paths, and offers optional folded-row tinting and thinking-text ink, with a settings page for six presets, colours and fonts.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的行内代码渲染为带语法色和可选文件标记的胶囊，并处理聊天中的文件路径；可选折叠动作行着色与思考文字彩虹刷入，设置页提供六套预设、颜色与字体选项。

description.en: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.
description.zh: 输入框代码引用折叠：粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」时自动折叠为「文件图标+文件名:行号」引用芯片（Ctrl+Z 可还原），发送时由 agent/pre-step 钩子将完整代码快照作为独立上下文消息注入给模型。0.5 起支持侧边栏「添加到对话框」大段选区（仅插路径行时按会话工作目录读磁盘取代码），并在捕获阶段抢权接管 Ctrl+V 粘贴。

description.en: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
description.zh: Code RAG 语义索引面板与设置卡片：输入框上方的实时索引条（开始/全量重建/取消），以及一键检测与配置（Qdrant/Ollama/预设/ignore）。

description.en: Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.
description.zh: 代码研读教练：交互式引导研读论文对应的开源代码。五段研读法（锚定论文主张、地形扫描、入口追踪、核心映射、闭环验证），自动识别并告知语言的框架与架构，适合研读 AI 论文源码。

description.en: Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.
description.zh: 基于 code-review-graph 引擎，为 DSH 提供代码图谱上下文、影响分析、审查工作流、交互式图谱和权限控制的重构。
