description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.
description.zh: 右栏的代码工作台：工作区文件树 + 多标签 Monaco 编辑器（语法高亮、版本守卫保存），基于 DeepSeek FIM 的 Tab 补全，按次保存的检查点与回滚，代码库检索（另提供 codebase_search 工具给 Agent），以及把选中代码以 @路径 mention 插入对话的引用胶囊。

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness: built-in Huawei Cloud OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window, with local per-account request and token usage.
description.zh: 把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness：内置华为云 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），也支持粘贴 token；登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 提供的模型，并展示本机按账号统计的请求数与 token 用量。

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的数字雨开屏动画、向两侧展开的矩形光门、可选的窗口恢复重播，以及可调色相的绿色界面主题。

description.en: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.
description.zh: 将本机已安装的 CodeGraph CLI 接入各会话的已索引项目，同项目共享一个 MCP 进程，并在工作目录或索引变化时更新会话级工具。

description.en: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

description.en: Community Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, quota display, per-session Fast and transport controls, and safe stream recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区 Codex 模型接入：支持 ChatGPT OAuth、Codex 模型、图片输入、额度展示、单会话 Fast 与传输控制，以及安全的流式恢复。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

description.en: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 上 GPT 模型的 Codex 风格编码工具与 agent 预设：exec_command、write_stdin、apply_patch、view_image，以及 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses API 两条路由，并桥接 DSH 原生的计划、提问、审批与压缩。长命令注册为 DSH 后台作业，输出首尾有界，可用 job_output 读取；每种子代理类型可独立指定 Preset、Provider、Model 与 Reasoning effort。

description.en: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
description.zh: 导入/上传 Codex 风格精灵图序列帧宠物，在 DSH Web GUI 以悬浮浮层渲染，含图库管理、交互与 Agent 状态联动。

description.en: Batch-port official Codex plugins into DSH skills (codex_list/port/status/health; measured: 186 plugins / 583 skills, 577 ported, 0 failures).
description.zh: Codex 官方插件一键移植为 DSH 技能（codex_list/port/status/health，实测 186 插件/583 技能，移植 577 个 0 失败）。

description.en: Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness with screenshots, UI Automation, 18 desktop tools, per-Agent activation, human-input handoff, approval prompts and prebuilt native workers.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操控：让 DeepSeek 看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘。提供截图、UIA 定位、18 个桌面工具、按 Agent 激活、人机共用和操作审批，原生组件随包提供。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or Codex CLI.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

description.en: Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅：OAuth 免密、额度续航预测、安全重置、联网搜索、生图与高速模式。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
description.zh: Codex 与 DSH 双向桥接：挂载 ~/.codex/skills、带工作区绑定的会话导入、mcp_servers 实时镜像，以及 Codex 端反向 MCP 安装器。

description.en: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
description.zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

description.en: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
description.zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

description.en: Coordinates Codex planning and independent review while the original DSH session implements and tests changes.
description.zh: 协调 Codex 制定计划和独立审查，由 DSH 原会话完成代码修改与测试。

description.en: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.
description.zh: 提供类似 Codex 的无项目草稿、各项目草稿切换及首次发送时按日期和主题创建目录的功能；支持 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，无需归档补丁或外部安装器。

description.en: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.
description.zh: 编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.
description.zh: 模型输出时演奏生成式背景音乐，完成、审批与等待操作各有独立提示音：不盯屏幕也能听出 Agent 在思考、仍在工作还是在等你。

description.en: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
description.zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

description.en: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.
description.zh: 把聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 的编辑器式输入面板：行号、编辑 + Markdown 预览分屏、悬浮窗与全高侧栏标签，同一时刻只有一个输入入口。草稿走官方输入机；宿主有语音输入按钮时原样渲染官方语音组件，数据行与上下文小圈与官方 dock 同源。

description.en: Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos, with a workflow library (graph extraction: per component / main flow / all), a load area with resolution auto-match, a live queue, SDXL and Wan 2.1 templates, a companion skill, and a same-origin media proxy.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接驱动本地或远程 ComfyUI：comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow 工具生成与编辑图像、视频，附带工作流库（图工作流提取：按分量 / 主流程 / 整体）、加载区分辨率自动匹配、实时队列、SDXL 与 Wan 2.1 模板、配套 skill 与同源媒体代理。

description.en: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.
description.zh: 从对话到画布再到作品——DSH 里驾驭 ComfyUI 的可视化工作流 IDE。把 ComfyUI（本地或云端）以画布分屏嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web，agent 在对话里激发创意、书写提示词与脚本，实时落到你眼前的画布上，产出图像、音乐、视频、3D。从灵感到成品，全程不离开对话，不用切换任何前端工具：画布操作——搭建编排、读写工作流、修改节点、连线、运行、调整参数、工作流查错，所见即所得，实时落在你眼前的画布上；生产任务——批量扫参（batch_run）、自动取回出图（get_outputs）带回对话，实现图像、音乐、视频、3D 等多任务智能创作与批量生产；环境维护——一键启动 ComfyUI、一键升级核心与全部自定义节点（upgrade），省心维护不间断。本仓库集成了 DSH 侧插件（画布副驾）+ ComfyUI 侧桥接节点，无人值守/规模化执行时可配合官方 ComfyUI MCP 服务器使用。

description.en: Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.
description.zh: 用本地 ComfyUI 出图：一个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘与去背景。

description.en: The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.
description.zh: 把真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器作为侧栏标签嵌进 DeepSeek Harness，每会话的工具直接读写屏幕上那张工作流，面板可启停 ComfyUI，且不向 ComfyUI 安装任何东西。

description.en: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.
description.zh: 注册 /code-review 斜杠命令，五个并行审查视角、逐发现置信度打分，同时支持拉取请求与本地代码审查。

description.en: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
description.zh: Command Code 余额与额度面板：在输入框下方显示可用余额，以及 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
description.zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

description.en: Context indicator for the DeepSeek Harness composer. Displays segmented session occupancy, compression points, pinned messages, and the native auto-compaction line (flashes red when crossed). Supports preview-then-confirm compaction (/bc), 9-section session handoff (/handoff), and message pinning (/pin). Configurable thresholds, colors, native auto-compaction toggle, legend, and onboarding replay in Settings → 压缩接力.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框上下文状态指示器：按压缩评估状态分段着色，标识建议压缩点、锁定消息位置与 DSH 原生自动压缩线（越线红闪告警）。支持预览后确认压缩（/bc）、生成九段式交接单并自动切换至新会话（/handoff）、锁定消息防压缩（/pin）。可在「设置 → 压缩接力」中配置阈值、配色、原生自动压缩开关，并查看图例与重播首次引导。

description.en: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
description.zh: 使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。

description.en: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.
description.zh: /compact 与自动压缩使用会话中当前选中的模型来生成摘要，而不是用跑完上一轮的那个模型。

description.en: Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.
description.zh: 接管所有已挂载压缩引擎的触发阈值：把 headroomTokens 强制成 −1e6，使比值成为触发点的唯一决定项；在每条下发路径上保证保留量低于触发点；把压缩调用改派到指定模型；并提供一键立即压缩与本会话压缩记录面板。

description.en: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.
description.zh: 压缩监护：从被压缩范围提取指令行（never/must/必须 类标记），对照摘要做逐字或内容词覆盖存续校验；会话悄悄遗忘的约束会被响亮上报并写入 JSONL 台账；配置中的 pinned 约束每次压缩必验。

description.en: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 不再过早压缩对话（把早期内容总结掉）。默认行为下，上下文窗口不大的模型（十几万 token 那种）常常在半满出头就开始压缩；装上它之后，压缩会等你设定的比例（默认 80%）到了才发生，并且可以按 provider/model 分别设置。它只改“什么时候压缩”，一次压缩保留哪些内容仍由 DSH 决定。

description.en: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件冲突与加载故障，隔离和恢复受影响的插件，并在宿主无法启动时提供离线修复。

description.en: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with an automatic backup before the change and rollback if the re-check fails.
description.zh: dsh 插件兼容性体检：把已装插件的 peerDependencies 与当前 dsh 运行时比对，提前指出哪些会在下次启动被预检拒绝加载，并给出可直接执行的中文修复命令；dsh web 顶部横幅可按键隔离、卸载或升级，改动前自动备份、复检不过自动回滚。

description.en: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

description.en: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. It saves important conditions and completion evidence locally, brings them back after context compaction or session resume, and stops partial work from being reported as the whole task done.
description.zh: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求：它会把重要条件和完成依据保存在本机，在上下文压缩或恢复会话后重新带回，防止漏掉关键限制，或只做完一部分就说整个任务已经完成。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 预设：标准模式的工具栈，外加写进人格提示的四条工作纪律——每个项目最多四个文档（项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步）；文档只写当前状态，不记 AI 修改历史、不留被推翻的旧方案；用户没有明确指令就不提交、不推送、不开 PR；动手前先复述目标与验收标准、只做手术式最小改动、没验证不说已修复，汇报用大白话。

description.en: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出各 DSH 工作区中的 Docker Compose 项目，按项目目录分组，显示容器状态，支持项目级与服务级 up/stop/restart 以及单服务日志流。

description.en: DSH input assistant for next-message prediction, draft autocomplete (text completion), and prompt polishing/rewrite. Session-local suggestions; Tab accepts into the draft without sending. Requires a configured model; calls may incur charges. Source-available; modifications require prior written permission.
description.zh: DSH 输入助手：输入预测、草稿补全（自动补全）、提示词润色（prompt 优化）；根据对话给出下一句建议。Tab 接受只填入草稿、不自动发送，建议按会话保留。需配置模型，调用可能计费。源码可见，修改须事先取得书面许可。

description.en: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.
description.zh: 让 DSH 0.1.5 Web 输入框使用 Enter 换行，同时保留 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交消息。

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框用 ↑ 调回本会话已发送的消息；↓ 前翻并恢复你正在写的草稿，再按一次 ↓ 丢弃草稿、清空输入框。

description.en: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框键位自定义：把 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 或任意组合键分配给发送、换行、打断三个动作，支持跨动作互斥迁移与持久化保存，默认保持 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
description.zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

description.en: Live Markdown rendering and typing enhancements for the DSH web composer - syntax-highlighted code blocks, list/quote continuation, format toolbars.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框 Markdown 实时渲染与输入增强——代码块语法高亮、列表引用续项、格式工具栏。

description.en: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Markdown 编辑增强：有序与无序列表续行且组内序号恒连续、Tab 层级缩进、行内代码样式、代码块围栏自动闭合；发送的草稿保持字面 Markdown。

description.en: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), ↑/↓ input history, Shift+Tab /plan toggle, one-click ▶ Continue after a stopped or failed turn, drag-and-drop queue reordering, Copy deeplink, Auto Review "Allow for this chat", project status markers with active projects first, background notifications, 11 extra UI languages and automatic updates from GitHub releases through the plugin manager.
description.zh: 一个插件集成多项输入框与侧边栏增强，均可在设置中单独开关：git 改动面板（未提交 / 未暂存 / 已暂存 / 分支差异）、↑/↓ 输入历史、Shift+Tab 切换 /plan、对话中断或失败后一键 ▶ 继续、拖拽调整排队消息顺序、复制会话链接、Auto Review「本对话内允许」、项目状态标记与活跃项目置顶、后台通知、11 种额外界面语言，以及通过插件管理器从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

description.en: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.
description.zh: 输入框全屏扩展按钮——内容达 3 行以上时出现，点击扩展至全屏高度，发送后自动折叠；扩展模式下 Enter 与 Shift+Enter 换行，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 发送。

description.en: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话输入框实时估算 token 数，将当前上下文基线与草稿合并计算，并区分精确计数与启发式估算。

description.en: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.
description.zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）、指令查看/编辑器（全局与项目级 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md）、提示词库（780 条中文提示词，源自 Cherry Studio agents-zh 语料，AGPL-3.0，一键插入输入框）。npm 包名 `dsh-composer-tools`。

description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。快捷指令存在全局文件 ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json 里，与会话、项目无关。

description.en: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.
description.zh: 通过组合来源路径和人工下一步解释受支持的 DSH 插件故障：重复引入、bundle patch 缺失和 peer 不匹配；提供独立 CLI 与报告查看器，默认只读离线诊断，未观察的 runtime 保留 unknown。

description.en: Launches the local compound-memory MCP server through uvx and injects a short usage reminder once per session.
description.zh: 通过 uvx 启动本地 compound-memory MCP server，并在每个会话注入一次简短的使用提醒。

description.en: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description.zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

description.en: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
description.zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

description.en: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
description.zh: Windows 桌面识图+模拟操作能力：截图→vision模型→模拟鼠标键盘，内置自进化应用技巧库。支持插件工具模式和纯skill模式双形态。

description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP stdio server over a PowerShell UIA backend exposing 22 desktop tools (UIA tree, screenshots, typed input, OCR, window management, failsafe).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 电脑操控：MCP stdio 服务器 + PowerShell UIA 后端，22 个桌面工具（UIA 树、截图、键鼠输入、OCR、窗口管理、急停保护）。

description.en: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键 Concise 输出风格开关：结果先行、少废话，工作深浅不变。每轮最终回答开头自动附「摘要」精华卡（划选即复制），按会话独立生效，headless/CLI 同样生效，支持 /concise 命令、style.md 自定义风格与本地 API。摘要卡内的链接与文件路径渲染为可点击 chip：网页跳转、本地文件用系统默认应用打开（v0.9+）。每步生成前自动重申摘要契约（v0.11.2+），实测根治审查报告/表格型回复的漏卡。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

description.en: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.
description.zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

description.en: Configuration vault for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, diff and safely roll back profile patches, plugin manifests, skills and workspace lists, with credentials excluded by default.
description.zh: 配置保险箱：为 DSH 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚设置补丁、插件清单、技能与规则、工作区列表，凭据默认排除。

description.en: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).
description.zh: DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。把运行期能力图谱与磁盘上的 cordis.patch.yml 层对齐，并与真正在运行的宿主（而不是 profile 里可能过期的副本）比对导入、peer 范围与配置，检出那些不会自己报错的静默故障：卡在 PENDING 等待无人提供的服务、浏览器半区注入了无人提供的客户端模块、两个插件注册同一个 tool id、Loader entry id 重复、某层停用又被后一层重新插入的行、导入了运行宿主未通过 exports 暴露的子路径、以及 inject 声明之间成环。每条结论都带证据、归属置信度与带风险分级的修复：用 --dry-run 在内存里试修并看修改前后差异，或用 --fix-out 拿到独立的 .patch.yml 文件自己挑（这些文件不会被 DSH 加载，挑错也不影响运行）。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
description.zh: 一键接入 Agnes 的语言、生图、视频模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；登录 Agnes 控制台后（重登需 AGNES_PASSWORD），可看额度窗口（5 小时请求、每周请求、每日图片、视频）、账号累计用量，以及输入框旁的用量胶囊；也支持接入 AgnesCode 桌面端模型（仅 Windows），令牌到期时重新读取桌面端登录态，撞限额自动退避重试。

description.en: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.
description.zh: 用你本机已登录的 AtomGit 免费额度，请 AtomCode 给代码做一次独立代码审查：模型通过`atomcode_ask` 工具自主调用审查；你也可以使用`/atomcode-review`命令，一键评审未提交改动 / 分支 / PR。本插件不读取 API key；输入框下方有用量胶囊显示 CodingPlan 额度。

description.en: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端已有的登录态，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，并提供 5 小时限额与周额度的只读额度概览。仅 Windows x64：凭据解密依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
description.zh: 将 MiniMax Code 的模型接入 DSH：复用桌面 App 登录态或用设备码自行登录，提供 Anthropic 兼容接入、动态模型目录、每日签到领取免费额度，以及跟随所选模型显示的积分余额与到期提示。

description.en: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.
description.zh: 一键接入魔搭社区的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与上下文窗口；还可查看免费魔粒余额、跳转到模型信息页，记录本地调用计数、趋势、限流事件，输入框旁另有用量胶囊显示余额与今日本地调用次数。上述功能仅需填入 API key，不需要登录账号。

description.en: Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.
description.zh: 把本机 opencode serve 目录里的全部免费模型（覆盖所有 provider，含你自定义的 provider）接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器，并禁用 OpenCode 原生工具，执行权留在 DSH。

description.en: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，实时模型发现、设置页逐个启停、一键写入 provider，免 key。

description.en: Brings the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client into DSH by reusing the API key that client already wrote, with a 30-model catalog and a per-model default thinking level.
description.zh: 复用超算互联网（SCNet）计算服务客户端已写入的 API key，把它的模型接入 DSH，带 30 个模型的目录与逐模型默认思考档位。

description.en: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
description.zh: 一键接入商汤 Token Plan的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；限频时自动退避重试，不会误判为额度耗尽；登录商汤控制台后，可查看用量胶囊、积分池、每模型消耗。也支持扫码登录小浣熊，接入其模型，查看模型消耗倍率，使用联网搜索。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 Trae 中国区模型接入 DSH，支持由 DSH 执行工具调用、账号切换，以及 Work/通用积分展示。

description.en: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
description.zh: 把本机多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型供应商，附带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控，以及模型配置设置卡片。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DSH, supports per-model image input opt-in, account switching, and a read-only credits overview with daily check-in.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型接入 DSH，支持逐模型图片输入开关、账号切换，以及带每日签到的只读积分概览。

description.en: Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
description.zh: 长文创作一致性守卫：扫描会话正文，发现人物年龄、等级、境界、年份等设定跨章节矛盾，点击直接跳转到冲突原文位置。

description.en: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
description.zh: 用二维码或六位配对码把手机连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后可远程发指令、看图片、回答审批；局域网内不依赖云端，异地走公网隧道。

description.en: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content details, evolution trends, compaction/injection events, and stats.
description.zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。

description.en: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness. Results above a configurable size carry a short inline id (\[#a1b2c3d4]); the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own archives/ folder and the context keeps a small recoverable stub with the file path. Originals stay in the append-only session log, so nothing is lost. Ships a settings panel with per-size-bucket recovery stats, thresholds that apply without restart, and a conditional reminder when results are waiting to be archived. Requires dsh-better-sidebar for the statistics panel.
description.zh: 模型驱动的工具结果归档插件。超过阈值的结果会带一个短内联编号（\[#a1b2c3d4]），模型把不再需要的 结果归档进会话自己的 archives/ 目录，上下文里只留一个可回捞的小存根（含文件路径）。原文同时保留在 只增的会话日志中，不会丢失。附带设置面板：按大小分桶的回收统计、改完立即生效的阈值、以及有待归档 结果时的条件提醒。统计面板需 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the integrated Message Forge.
description.zh: 上下文控制台：通过轨迹墙与库存视图检查并模拟 DSH 上下文消费，并由内置消息锻造台创建、注入、导入或安全修复会话消息。

description.en: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.
description.zh: 上下文占用档位、按模型窗口推算的每会话压缩阈值、按缓存读取/写入费率计算的单步费用、缓存命中率、DeepSeek 余额与高峰/低谷费率，以及一键交接。它从不调用模型，也不消耗 token。

description.en: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).
description.zh: 为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45% 时空闲自动压缩，并将被压缩区段归档到磁盘。引擎以一行配置挂载到 agent preset（见 docs/dsh-integration.md）。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context at session start, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.2.3 targets DSH 0.1.7+ (hardened for 0.2.0-rc.2+); use 0.1.x on DSH 0.1.5.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。v0.2.3 适配 DSH 0.1.7+（已加固 0.2.0-rc.2+），DSH 0.1.5 请用 0.1.x。

description.en: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. Ships ctk_stats and ctk_doctor plus a settings page with a live context-occupancy panel. No third-party runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 让大块输出不进对话：ctk_execute、ctk_execute_file 与 ctk_batch_execute 在子进程里跑代码只回结论，ctk_index 与 ctk_search 把长材料存进基于 node:sqlite 的本地 FTS5 知识库，路由门禁在执行前拦下 curl 与 wget。附 ctk_stats、ctk_doctor 与带实时上下文占用面板的设置页，零第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
description.zh: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

description.en: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
description.zh: 在底部聊天输入框的模型选择弹窗中扩展第三行【上下文窗口】，支持 64K~2M 档位切换、自定义容量输入、提供商批量同步与自适应压缩防失败守卫。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

description.en: Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 自带的压缩摘要器，改用五段式交接摘要，被压掉的每条消息都能在分段目录里读回。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

description.en: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
description.zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

description.en: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
description.zh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

description.en: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.
description.zh: 同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程内对话之间的对等通信：列出工作区里的对话、用昵称连接、发消息而不必等对方当前一轮结束、不唤醒对方地查看进度，并给自己声明工具调用规则。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
description.zh: DSH 网页端对话导航点 — 快速跳转用户消息。

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中已结束回合的过程行折叠成一个可展开的总结，同时保留最终答案可见。

description.en: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单或会话页头部删除对话，可勾选一并删除该对话关联的记忆节点（确认框先显示命中条数）；删除进入插件回收站可恢复，每次操作写入审计日志，批量删除有限流与逐会话回滚。

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
description.zh: 当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。

description.en: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.
description.zh: 桌面宠物「照照」：透明置顶窗悬浮于所有应用之上，镜像 DeepSeek Harness 状态——待机、颠锅、上菜、托腮等你回话，支持点击回应、拖拽、右键调大小，Electron 运行时自动下载。

description.en: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
description.zh: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏添加 Git 管理功能，支持 commit | pull | push | branch | diff 等基础功能。

description.en: Terminal plugin — a real shell, workspace sync, persistent state, common-command management, and command completion.
description.zh: 终端插件 — 真 shell、工作区同步、状态常驻、常用命令管理、命令补全。

description.en: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.
description.zh: 主题插件 —— 支持深色/浅色外观切换，提供 34 款预设主题，支持创建/分享/导入自定义主题。

description.en: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.
description.zh: 提供按行复制工具，可替换或插入文件片段，并支持缩进控制和 diff 预览。

description.en: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中常驻显示已绑定的高驰手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开一句话点评与建议。

description.en: DeepSeek-Harness plugin for multi-model orchestration with recursive task decomposition, dynamic routing, quality gates, failure recovery, and KPI reporting.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 多模型编排插件，支持递归任务拆解、动态路由、质量门控、失败恢复与 KPI 报表。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

description.en: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 会话与当日 API 费用统计、预算图框（已用%）、官方余额、历史看板，支持峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。

description.en: Account balance and cost statistics pill for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining the billing period (peak/off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance and the current session cost; clicking it expands a per-session breakdown with cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The rate table is refreshed with plugin releases to follow official pricing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的账户余额及费用统计胶囊。它在会话输入框下方的官方统计行右侧新增一枚胶囊，集成计费时段（高峰/低谷，用颜色区分）、账户余额与会话费用；点击展开可查看本次会话的详细费用统计，包括缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出三项金额，以及按模型拆分的花费。费率表随插件版本更新，以跟随官方调价。

description.en: Shows what each assistant turn cost under every reply, priced from the token usage of that turn at the official peak and off-peak CNY rates, together with the account and bonus balances; when a turn cannot be priced it states the reason instead of guessing.
description.zh: 在每条助手回复下面显示本次问答的花费、账户余额与礼金余额，按该轮 token 用量乘官方峰谷单价计算；算不出价时写明原因，不猜测。

description.en: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.
description.zh: 在每次工具结果后注入上一段思考中已确立的结论，使模型直接沿用而非重复推导。

description.en: Turns course files (PPTX, PDF, DOCX, Markdown) into an outline, per-chapter key points with quoted evidence, Bilibili video picks, syllabus coverage, and Anki/JSON exports.
description.zh: 把课程文件（PPTX、PDF、DOCX、Markdown）解析成目录、带原文引证的分章要点、B 站网课推荐与考纲覆盖检查，并可导出 Anki 卡片和 JSON。

description.en: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
description.zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

description.en: A shared todo list for DeepSeek Harness: you and your agent manage the same tasks from a sidebar page or todo tools, with per-project and global todos, and one-click task references into the composer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人机共享待办：你和 AI 通过侧边栏或待办工具管理同一份任务，支持项目级与全局待办，并可一键把任务引用进输入框。

description.en: Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.
description.zh: 通过对话中的固定工具创建、激活、检查和移除外部 DSH 插件，需要外部 DSHX 开发工具。

description.en: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
description.zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 跨工作区消息与发送方导航、同工作区受限上下文，以及可选的本机 Claude Code 双向通信。

description.en: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话派活与协同：新建顶层任务会话并投递任务，用 base62 会话别名读取或干预，并通过审批桥批准子会话的沙箱提权——命中破坏性删除一律强制拒绝。

description.en: Ports CSDN blog article typography into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, inline code and Atom One syntax highlighting, in matching light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文的配色与正文排版搬进 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、行内代码与 Atom One 语法高亮，浅色深色各一套。

description.en: Teaching-first CTF solving skill: narrates each step's pattern, tool choice and underlying mechanism, then writes a reproducible writeup under solves/<challenge>/ gated by a nine-section check.
description.zh: 教学式 CTF 解题技能：每步讲清套路、工具选型与底层原理，收尾在 solves/<题目名>/ 生成可复现 Writeup，并用九章质量门校验。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放整个 Harness 网页界面，以指针位置为锚点、50%–200% 每档 10%；另支持 Ctrl 加减号与 Ctrl+0 快捷键；右下角缩放胶囊与「设置 → 通用」里的页面缩放行显示当前档位并可一键复位；档位保存在 localStorage。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.
description.zh: 通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。

description.en: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.
description.zh: Cubox 收藏同步：定时同步收藏，按你的 prompt 用 LLM 生成今日收藏简报直接写入 Obsidian，可导出每张收藏为 Markdown。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: A fiction-writing workbench for DSH with chapter editing, shared plot canvases, grouped character and world settings, writing presets, and scoped import/export for author-agent collaboration.
description.zh: 催更姬：DSH 小说写作工作台，支持章节编辑、共享剧情画布、人物与世界设定分组、写作预设和按范围导入导出，供作者与 AI 一起讨论和推进故事。

description.en: Hands standalone jobs to the Cursor CLI signed in on the same machine, with CLI readiness and proxy diagnostics, child-model settings, and a read-only connectivity test.
description.zh: 将独立任务交给同机已登录的 Cursor 命令行，并提供命令行就绪/代理诊断、子模型设置和只读连通性测试。

description.en: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
description.zh: 把本机 Cursor CLI 当作子编码智能体：提供 `cursor_code` 工具与原生一次性 `cursor_subagent` 工具，每次运行镜像为一个真实的 DSH 子会话，可按任务选模型、会话可续聊，返回逐步工具时间线与真实文件 diff，并提供额度、模型和会话面板。

description.en: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: Adds configurable HTTP header profiles that can be selected per model.
description.zh: 添加可配置的 HTTP 请求头配置档，并支持按模型选择。

description.en: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.
description.zh: 所有工作区共用的长期系统提示词：在 DSH 自己的设置面板里新增「自定义指令」页，文本会加入每个会话（含子代理）的系统提示词，并保存在 profile 而不是任何项目里。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理和热重载可信的 JavaScript / TypeScript 用户脚本。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 报关单证一致性检查：按规则 ID 输出字段级发现。

description.en: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.
description.zh: 在 Harness 工作区后播放静音循环视频，并在开屏动画结束后将输入区域显示为半透明。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass skin for the DSH Web GUI, themed after Cyrene from Honkai Star Rail. Also rewrites the agent persona (editable from the sidebar), adds Cyrene reaction stickers, replaces the new-session hero with her, and adds a full-page background picker with enable / pick / rotate / fade. Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成昔涟（《崩坏：星穹铁道》）的粉白渐变毛玻璃主题，附带侧边栏可编辑的人格设定、昔涟表情包、新会话欢迎页形象，以及可开关 / 选图 / 轮换 / 调淡的整页背景图。非官方非商业同人作品；昔涟及相关美术素材版权归米哈游（miHoYo / HoYoverse）所有，与官方无隶属或背书关系。

description.en: Cloudflare D1 tools for agents: d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health over the D1 HTTP API, read-only by default with a SQLite-accurate lexical guard, LIMIT row cap, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: Cloudflare D1 数据库工具：d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，通过 D1 HTTP API 访问，默认只读（SQLite 语义的词法级只读保护）、LIMIT 行数上限、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面追踪 DeepSeek Token 用量、单次与会话费用及账户余额，并显示缓存感知的扣费动画。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复读出来，带可拖动的挂件开关与一键部署。需预装 Python 3.10–3.12（安装器只负责定位，不负责安装）；建议约 5 GB 磁盘与 GPU。

description.en: Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.
description.zh: 道一-易经推演：通用决策评审 DSH 插件（决策辅助，非迷信）。六层加权聚合引擎（384爻→64卦→8宫→四象→三才→两仪→太极），强关联一票否决，内置电机设计/股票趋势/商业成功率剧本，纯 JS 零求解器依赖。免费档每日限 9 次推演，激活码可提升；stock-trend 剧本会按请求里的股票代码向腾讯行情接口拉取实时行情。

description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切换落盘成可审计的 JSONL 日志。切换只记入这份审计日志，不再写入会话内的提示行——宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Read-only preview of SQLite files and MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server connections in the right sidebar, with tables, paged rows, columns, indexes and draggable column widths, never writing to the database.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏只读预览 SQLite 文件与 MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server 连接：表、分页数据、列、索引，列宽可拖动，从不写库。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Safe, audited SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL access for dsh agents: schema introspection, enforced read-only queries, a write approval gate, and a durable JSONL SQL audit trail.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供安全且可审计的 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 访问：schema 内省、强制只读查询、写审批门与持久化 JSONL SQL 审计追踪。

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。

description.en: Database access for DeepSeek Harness through the DBHub MCP server: configure MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server connections per workspace and environment, then let the agent configure, list, query and search SQLite objects through four fixed tools. Passwords and full connection strings are entered in the settings UI and never accepted as tool arguments, so the model only sees metadata such as mysql://host:3306/db; each environment can be read-only (the model may enable it but not clear it) or reached through a manual SSH tunnel. Every call runs its own short-lived dbhub process and dbhub installs itself when missing.
description.zh: 把 DBHub MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness 的数据库插件：按工作区 × 环境配置 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQLite 与 SQL Server 连接，让 Agent 通过固定 4 个工具配置连接、列出数据源、执行 SQL、搜索 SQLite 对象。密码与完整连接串由用户在设置界面输入、不作为工具参数接收，模型只看到 mysql://host:3306/db 这类元数据；每个环境可设为只读（模型只能开启、不能关闭）或经手动 SSH 隧道访问。每次调用独立启动一条用完即退的 dbhub 进程，未安装 dbhub 时自动安装。

description.en: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.
description.zh: 多智能体中文辩论模拟：8 名辩手、实时双栏讨论与草稿纸、评委计分、单边计时、每轮 ZIP 归档、训练方可选胜率阈值或固定轮次收官，并生成 Word 备赛包。

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: 阅读视图增强插件——执行过程自动收起、右缘消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，支持生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）沙箱交互。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先注意力监督，提供 C0–C3 策略、去重 Inbox 提醒、静默时段和脱敏结果记录。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.
description.zh: 五种模式精读图书与文章（快速/深度/知识地图/费曼/全书），输出观点—证据—数据报告、四档置信度、Mermaid/XMind 思维导图，支持批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，可导出 MD/MM/HTML。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）与距下次切换的倒计时，点击可展开高峰/空闲时段规则；高峰时段发送消息前会先拦截并弹出确认。

description.en: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版中提供 DeepSeek 网页聊天与 Harness 工作区之间的切换。

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 复刻 DeepSeek 官网风格的主题皮肤：流体粒子背景、玻璃拟态侧边栏与输入框、运行中子代理面板与 DSTT 高峰时段配色。

description.en: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

description.en: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
description.zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-web` provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, so no Open Platform API key is needed: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the `default` model, and `/clean` is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2: the peer ranges are widened so the compatibility gate no longer rejects the whole bundle, the removed settings API is replaced with `ctx.settings.configure()` plus `.volatile()` config fields, the renamed client icons are updated, and an upstream SSE error now surfaces as a real error instead of an empty message that poisoned the session history. The fork also repairs what the rename to `-free` left behind: the session-list route used to derive its suffix from a hard-coded length inherited from the old package name, which had turned every conversation request into a 404 while sign-in still worked; and the sidebar conversation panel now paints on an opaque surface token instead of the host's translucent menu token, which only reads as a menu beside the backdrop blur a body-mounted panel cannot install.
description.zh: 把你已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作额外模型接入 DSH：注册 `deepseek-web` provider，无需 Open Platform API key；侧边栏底部列出你的网页端会话，「Fork to Workspace」会开一个独立的 Harness 会话、不回写原对话，`default` 模型保持网页端原生搜索，`/clean` 是只发送人类文本的会话开关。本包是 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork，已适配 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2：放宽 peer 范围以免被兼容性门禁整包拒绝、用 `ctx.settings.configure()` 与配置字段 `.volatile()` 替代被移除的 settings API、更新已改名的客户端图标、并让上游 SSE 错误直接报错（不再返回空消息污染会话历史）。此外还修掉了改名为 `-free` 后遗留的两处问题：会话列表路由原先按旧包名继承下来的硬编码长度切分路径，导致登录正常但每个会话请求都返回 404；侧边栏会话浮层原先用宿主的半透明菜单色，而该色只有配合磨砂背景才像菜单、挂到 body 上的面板无法安装磨砂，现已改用不透明表面色。

description.en: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.
description.zh: 新增 deepseek-web provider，把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端模型接入 DSH：浏览器登录抓取、PoW 请求签名、SSE 流式传输与基于提示词的工具调用。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
description.zh: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

description.en: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
description.zh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

description.en: Reads the session files thirty-three other coding agents on this machine already wrote — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more — including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh: 读取本机上其他三十三个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件——Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等，包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页中归档、恢复并删除会话。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
description.zh: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. When the model builds web pages, app screens, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer. Also has a design tokens panel, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, image export, a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through demo mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a bundled ui-design skill plus a preview_page tool.
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。模型做网页、App 界面、海报、幻灯片、邮件时，每个 HTML 文件在画布上显示为一屏，套设备外框，文件一改就刷新；本地开发服务器经代理接入，热更新照常。点一个元素或框一块区域，选择器、源文件和样式就整理进输入框。另有设计变量面板、每轮对话前后自动存版本（拖动对比、回到某一版）、导出图片、局域网扫码在手机上看、页面跳转箭头和点击演示、多尺寸并排、预览里直接改字、参考图取色，并自带 ui-design 技能和 preview_page 工具。

description.en: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
description.zh: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

description.en: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.
description.zh: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。
