Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

description.en: Glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: frosted translucent surfaces with adjustable opacity, blur radius and saturation, ambient lighting and accent palettes, plus a custom background image with cover, contain, stretch, tile or center fit and crop, all persisted from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的毛玻璃主题：磨砂半透明表面，可调不透明度、模糊半径与饱和度，支持氛围光与配色方案，并可设置自定义背景图片（填充、适应、拉伸、平铺、居中与裁剪），全部参数保存在设置页中。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a card-grid detail panel with limits, reset times, 24h per-model token usage and one-click plugin self-update.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行常驻 GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill(含 5 小时窗口重置倒计时),点击展开双列卡片式详情面板:各窗口限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量与小时级 sparkline,支持插件一键自更新。

description.en: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的全局跨会话待办清单，人和 agent 共用同一份：十个 global_todo_* 工具可在任意会话中新增、批量抓取、修改、挂文档与链接、追加进展记录、标记完成；每条待办可按四种方式交给 agent 会话，派发结果记回条目本身。清单存成一个 JSON 文件。

description.en: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束时向 Gotify 服务器推送通知，支持模板、优先级与按结束原因区分标题。

description.en: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server) and a ChatGPT login; API-key logins expose no subscription quota.
description.zh: Tokyo 的可拖动陪伴挂件，支持 Codex 额度监控、手动程序定位和可编辑回复。需安装 Codex CLI（codex app-server）并使用 ChatGPT 登录；API-key 登录不显示订阅额度。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

description.en: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框中切换原生 DSH Agent 与 Grok Build，并通过 ACP 代理 Grok Build 会话及斜杠命令。

description.en: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Grok：模型发现、图片与视频生成、文字转语音工具，以及可重启恢复的本地媒体任务。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.
description.zh: Grok Build 模型接入插件：使用官方 CLI 浏览器登录，动态发现账号可见模型，支持流式推理、工具调用、额度与模型能力设置页。

description.en: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)
description.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。（侧栏徽标 / 分组状态 / 聚合）

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7 子进程上；不需要 MCP 服务器、无常驻进程、无 API key。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings UI.
description.zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

description.en: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
description.zh: 面向小上下文模型的 DSH 上下文压缩插件：压缩大小可视化配置，默认 8k 交接摘要 + 16k 最近上下文，完整历史仍可查询。

description.en: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.
description.zh: 输入框旁一枚金色开关：把每次模型请求的推理强度提到当前模型声明的最高档、输出上限提到其 defaultMaxTokens，并在系统提示里追加一段要求穷尽检索、逐条自检的工作纪律。

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

description.en: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.
description.zh: 把DSH的任务结果，以服务卡片形式推送到华为鸿蒙负一屏。安装后请在插件设置页输入授权码，位置：主页面左上角「插件」→ 「dsh-harmonyos-hiboard」。

description.en: Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化多智能体 DAG 工作流，支持实时执行、重启恢复和飞书集成。

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.
description.zh: 从侧栏打开的整页控制台面板，含八个标签：总览；从 sessions 服务读取的会话列表（标题、目录、运行状态、更新时间，带筛选）；从 pluginInventory 与 pluginManager 读取的已装 bundle 与 Loader 条目，每个 bundle 带启用开关；列出 GitHub 搜索 API 中 topic:dsh-plugin 公开仓库的插件市场；一个模型与供应商编辑器，通过 remote.settings.mutate 写入 llm-pi-ai 配置命名空间（切换会话模型、新增或编辑供应商及其模型列表、经 remote.credentials 保存 API Key，并以合并方式写入以免表单未暴露的字段被覆盖）；MCP 与技能两个标签；以及一个读取宿主回环 /api/dsh-usage/overview 文档的用量标签。所需服务通过 ctx.inject 声明，缺少任一服务的部署只是不挂载该面板，不会崩溃。

description.en: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

description.en: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的内部自洽性：每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复。只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
description.zh: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
description.zh: 三通道任务通知：页内浮层与提示音、浏览器系统横幅、宿主直发系统通知（浏览器关闭也送达），附铃铛面板与持久历史。

description.en: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)
description.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr（含 DSH 本身没有的 blocked 等待态），支持面板跳转与 --wait。（状态上报 / 状态显示 / 终端集成 / 面板跳转）

description.en: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
description.zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

description.en: Reads a local Hermes Agent session store read-only and imports sessions into the current conversation as bounded, untrusted background context: a composer button opens a searchable list across every profile, plus the hermes_sessions_list and hermes_session_import tools.
description.zh: 只读读取本机 Hermes Agent 的会话库，把会话导入当前会话作为有界、不可信的背景上下文：输入框按钮可搜索全部 profile 的会话，另有 hermes_sessions_list 与 hermes_session_import 两个工具。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

description.en: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).
description.zh: 可拖动的余额与用量浮层卡片：点一下角色图片，卡片从图片左侧滑出，再点一下缩回；显示官方 DeepSeek 余额（赠金 / 充值拆分），并按缓存命中、未命中、输出三段计价，汇总本地会话日志的今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月 token 用量与人民币估算花费（按官方峰谷时段逐次计价）。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
description.zh: 把已定稿的用户或助手消息里划选的一段原文钉住，让它在上下文压缩后仍留在模型输入中：每枚钉子默认按需补回，也可改为 resident（中性常驻系统提示词）或 highlight（强调常驻）。选区会以 source-exact、source-normalized 或 rendered 三级保真对回源文本，三个级别各有独立的字符预算。

description.en: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
description.zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.
description.zh: 让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, and a cross-session canary alarm.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原，以及蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

description.en: Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
description.zh: 插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，无需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

description.en: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的一个固定按钮，点一下就把 DSH 关掉并自动重开，全程没有控制台窗口；右键它还有内置自检，能生成一份自包含的诊断报告。

description.en: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.
description.zh: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish the changes as one commit over the GitHub REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

description.en: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件：前台弹页面内 toast，后台按可用性切换 PWA 系统通知（Service Worker）或浏览器通知兜底；任务完成、审批请求、提问、计划评审、出错等事件可逐项开关，重要通知驻留不消失，并用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音效、零音频文件零网络上报。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.
description.zh: 常驻的 ADHD 友好输出塑形：一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、时间估算具体；adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status 三个工具让模式跨重启保持。

description.en: Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，提示需要编码员关注的 ICD 编码配对——剑号与星号组合、合并编码。只报告发现的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

description.en: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.
description.zh: 在模型写出的每句话结尾（含思维链）补一个小冰块标记，并为每次补冰播放一声短促的合成音效。

description.en: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

description.en: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的工作区文件树与代码编辑器：跟随所在会话的工作区，新建 / 重命名 / 删除文件与文件夹（默认进回收站），带行号与语法高亮地编辑、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制当前行，可预览图片、播放音频视频、查看并解压压缩包或用系统 tar 打包成 zip，能按文件名搜索或粘贴路径跳转，Windows 下图标用系统自己那套（SHGetFileInfo）。

description.en: JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 JetBrains 式 IDE 工作台：Project 文件树、Commit 面板、泳道图 Git 历史、真实 PTY 终端与内置编辑器（Markdown 预览、全项目查找），并支持聊天文件链接与发送到聊天框的 @ 引用。

description.en: Compacts a long session after a configurable idle time when its context exceeds a configurable token threshold, before the provider KV cache expires; both values are set on the plugin's page in the Plugins manager.
description.zh: 会话上下文超过可配置的 token 阈值、且用户空闲达到可配置时长后，在模型 KV 缓存过期前自动压缩会话；两项设置都在插件管理器的插件页面中修改。

description.en: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.
description.zh: DSH 的 IM 联合桥：整合社区同类插件（xmanrui/dsh-im、MichengAI/dsh-im-connect）能力合集的独立实现——用 12 个平台的 15 个渠道适配器（含邮件；企微/钉钉/QQ 各含机器人与自建应用或推送两档）驱动宿主会话——微信（官方 iLink 扫码绑定）、飞书（长连接+流式卡片，语音档需系统 ffmpeg）、Telegram、Discord、企微智能机器人与自建应用（回调验签）、钉钉（stream+AI Card 与自定义机器人推送）、QQ 官方机器人（另含推送档）、Slack（Socket Mode）、WhatsApp（Baileys 扫码，依赖以插件包 optionalDependencies 随包分发）、Matrix、iMessage（仅 macOS）、邮件（IMAP/SMTP 线程路由）。跨版本窄腰在 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 宿主间（12 tag 枚举，rc.2 已按桌面 profile 装机双回读实证）以能力探测自适配设置面 gen1/gen2/gen3（禁版本号分支）；IM 内 25 命令面板、工具审批与交互提问原聊天闭环（默认拒绝、发起者限定、5 分钟超时）、图片/文件输入（宿主元数据判视觉）、产物文件回传、投递日志限额补发（结果不明绝不重发）、主动投递与碎片续写；原生侧栏「任务/频道」两页签自持分离（检测到该槽位已被其它插件接管则完全不插手）、im-concise 智能体预设配合出站净化把 GenUI 围栏与裸 HTML 等富结构挡在纯文字聊天之外、svg 围栏自动渲染为 PNG 图片发送、模型白名单护栏、/relay 把每回合最终回答镜像到通知渠道（按账号 ID 或别名绑定，歧义不猜）。secret 单向入凭据库，永不回显。npm 包名：`dsh-im-union`。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

description.en: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。

description.en: Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 在设置中配置多个生图供应商，对话通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型；图片保存到工作区 generate/image，并在对话中内联显示。

description.en: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
description.zh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them inline in the conversation; ships a standalone CLI as well.
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立 CLI。

description.en: Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，双模式：对话中由模型调用 image_generate_lite 工具出图，或在右侧栏「生图工作台」手动生图；最多 5 张参考图、支持 OpenAI images 接口格式，密钥存于 DSH 凭据服务。

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
description.zh: 让超大图片以可读分辨率进入模型视野，而不是被压成一张缩图：准入前按附件存储允许的上限把大图切成多张切片（8000x8000 的截图会变成 20 张 2000x1600），小字得以保留。以替换本地附件存储的方式实现，不新增任何配置项。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL 返回），图片保存在会话工作目录内，并借助其 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 依赖在对话里内联渲染。

description.en: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.
description.zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered edit marks with per-mark instructions, solid-background removal, brush-mask erase, resize and crop presets; results return to the composer as attachments plus a manifest capsule) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (three priority tiers, drag reordering, per-channel model fallback chains, arrears-aware balance probing, ChatGPT-web account store) that writes the resolved providers back to the skills .env files.
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整，结果以附件 + manifest 清单胶囊回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（三级优先级、拖拽排序、每通道模型降级链、欠费探测自动关停、ChatGPT 网页出图账号库），保存后写回两个 skill 的 .env。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.
description.zh: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App（PWA）。公网与局域网两个入口可随时切换；在手机上读会话、子代理、目标轮次、工作流、后台任务与待审批，和任意会话实时对话（流式回复、工具调用进度、随时停止、切换会话与模型），消息可排队并「立即发送」，支持上传与交付文件。另含 GUI 侧边栏面板；原名 dsh-taskwatch，npm 包已改为 dsh-in-hand。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
description.zh: 网页加载时在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上播放一段水墨鲸跃动画，随后自行淡出。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
description.zh: 选中即批注，刷新亦留存；随消息发送，模型逐条回应。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM 上下文校对，文中红波浪线标注、逐条导航、点击修正。

description.en: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供提示词优化、下一句预测、输入续写与当前会话草稿暂存。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched and keeping multi-part questions numbered.
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话自动改写成更容易得到好答案的样子；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

description.en: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件运维面板：展示 Profile 插件树、Loader 真实 fiber 状态、能力/依赖/兼容性、本轮会话插件活动与上游来源/版本核验，支持一键关闭/启用/更新/卸载，并提供 DSH 未运行时也能打开的独立启动失败诊断页。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.
description.zh: DSH Web 实例管理器：Mini Utility Dock 面板列出本机可见的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数、常驻内存、版本），可在 3080–3129 自动选一个空闲端口或按指定端口启动新实例、把某一行在新标签页打开，并通过目标实例自身的优雅退出停掉单个或全部实例。行内还显示每个实例在跑什么，只读的实例日志与会话概要一点即达。配置了 peer 时，同一个面板会通过带 bearer 鉴权的链路列出并查询其他机器上的实例。所有路由都做回环校验，面向浏览器的操作还要额外通过宿主自身的鉴权。

description.en: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
description.zh: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不需要错误分类、退避策略或配置界面。与通用自动续跑插件相比，它还覆盖「子代理执行中被中断」的盲区：此时父代理的轮次已正常结束（正在等待子代理），常规判定看不到任何可续对象，整棵子代理树会静默死掉；本插件会识别出被中断的子代理并唤醒父代理。单个宿主文件、零外部依赖、七个配置常量。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel.
description.zh: Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
description.zh: 注册 janitor_scan 工具：对会话遗留物（计划文档、临时脚本）给出确定性、可审阅的清理计划，逐文件裁决附证据；只扫描，永不删除。

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

description.en: Jenkins CI integration with a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar, a multi-instance settings page, five model-facing tools (list jobs, build status, console log, workspace, trigger build), and a failure wake that hands a failed followed build to the conversation that followed it.
description.zh: Jenkins CI 集成：右侧栏实时构建进度面板、多实例设置页、五个面向模型的工具（列 job、构建状态、控制台日志、工作区、触发构建），以及构建失败时唤醒当初关注该 job 的那个会话。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, with recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layout persistence, temporary decision preferences, and optional request previews with common-credential masking.
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见卡片，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持推荐分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片位置与折叠状态及临时决策偏好，并提供可选发送前预览和常见凭证遮盖。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。

description.en: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 上用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的非生成式决策模型）对待执行的工具调用分类——高置信高危拒绝、存疑转审批——并在 approval/request 上对明确授权且可逆的调用做带参数证据门控的自动批准。另子类化 session-reference resolver，让引用快照按 Jev 打分保留消息而非最旧优先丢弃。任何 provider 故障均回退原生行为；提供 shadow 模式与 /jev-stats 统计命令；支持 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 入口；64 个测试。

description.en: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.
description.zh: 通过 JeV 筛选并外显思考中的任务规划、进展和阶段小结，支持轻量摘要、DSH 原生翻译（需 JeV Key，会外部调用 Jev 服务并可能计费）及父子任务、串并行流程图。

description.en: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.
description.zh: 降低 LLM 成本：Jev（System One）分类器按声明式策略审查每一轮任务并推荐 subagent 模型路由，让常规工作以 flash 价格运行、主模型专注难点；显式 /route 触发、运行时代理能力门控、凭据脱敏，以及基于判定日志的离线策略回放。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.
description.zh: 0.8.6 修复了一个会让宿主起不来的依赖问题（宿主运行时包改为 optional peer，永不被安装）。为 DeepSeek Harness 端到端接入 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）0.8.6。共七个工具：jev_decision（一次并行完成 1-25 个原子判定；noul/choice/score；返回类型化答案与校准置信度；实测中位 266-484 ms；只出判定不写文本）、jev_choose（对 2-10 个候选并行打分——契合度 0-3 与风险——合成综合分并给推荐，只给分不解释）、jev_batch（0.8.6 新增：一次调用对 1-20 条文本跑同一组 1-5 个判定，每条文本一次真实调用、并发有上限，返回可直接粘贴的 markdown 表格并可按某个判定维度排序；内置 sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam 预设；失败的行如实标为失败并附原文错误，绝不猜测）、jev_usage（本机实测用量：调用、tokens、估算成本、延迟中位与 p95、按工具分布、滚动窗口、全天用量预测、可选的本地硬预算，以及自报余额推算出的剩余）、jev_overview（会话账本）、jev_guard_status（护栏计数，并用 registrations 暴露分面注册失败）与 jev_verify（对线上 API 6 路并发运行冻结的 27 题基准：96.3%，26/27）。0.8.6 的三件事：账本扛得住重启、剩余是算出来的而不是编出来的、插件开始干批量整理的活。 （1）本地账本默认写入 $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json，宿主重启后累计不再清零。此前「明明有调用、面板却是 0」背后是两个真 bug：账本路径只认 DSH_HOME（宿主进程里没有这个变量，于是持久化被静默关闭、file 为 null），以及 save() 在首次 load 之前执行，把尚未载入的空内存环覆盖写到了历史文件上，而紧随其后的那次保存又被节流窗口吞掉。 （2）剩余只推算、不编造：TypeSafe 没有任何余额接口——/v1/usage、/v1/quota、/v1/account、/v1/account/balance、/v1/balance、/v1/credits、/v1/billing、/v1/me、/v1/limits 等十几个路径全部 404，只有 /v1/models 有响应且响应头没有任何余额字段——因此面板把「剩余」显示为你在 quota.declaredBalanceUsd 自报的余额减去 quota.balanceSince 起的本机实测花费，没自报时明确写「剩余无法显示」，绝不印一个数字。 （3）输入框胶囊的刷新周期从 60 秒改为 20 秒，刚跑完的调用不用等就能看到。 （4）自报余额后，折叠胶囊以「剩余」为首，账本落盘后累计行改名。每个工具都有对话内结构化视图；「设置 → 插件」卡片覆盖凭据、工具开关、自动护栏、看板、引导段、使用额度与 autoTriage。 诚实设计：未配置 Key 时给出明确报错、绝不伪造结果；任何分面注册失败都被隔离，只降级一个功能。 测试 38/38（npm test，约 2.5 s）。客户端部分刷新页面即生效；服务端部分需重启宿主。

description.en: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.en: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。

description.en: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

description.en: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.
description.zh: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.
description.zh: 提供可直接编辑的笔记空间，支持文件夹、全文搜索、富文本、核对清单、可调整列宽的表格、附件、导出和可选的 Agent 协作。

description.en: A daily journal the agent keeps: the journal_record tool appends dated todos and memories, with optional detail and tags, to one JSON file per day under the DSH home; the right sidebar draws those files as a month calendar marked per day by open todos, finished todos or memories, with checkable todos and the selected day's entries below; and the duty sentence it adds to the system prompt is editable from the calendar itself.
description.zh: 助手替你维护的每日日志：journal_record 工具把带时间的待办与记事（可选详情与标签）追加到 DSH home 下一天一个的 JSON 文件；右侧栏把这些文件画成月历，单元格按「有待办未完成 / 待办已完成 / 只有记事」标记，下方是可勾选的待办与所选日期的条目；它加入系统提示词的那句职责文案，可以直接在日历上编辑。

description.en: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
description.zh: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复按情绪添加日文颜文字，词库精选自颜文字屋（kaomojiya.org），可在「设置 → 通用设置」中调整。

description.en: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.
description.zh: 宫崎骏《起风了》主题皮肤：全屏电影壁纸配毛玻璃界面，交互色统一为天蓝，侧边栏与首页改用自绘矢量徽标，输入卡重绘为主题化占位文案的云海蓝胶囊，并为消息列加 40px 底部渐隐。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: five tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
description.zh: 本地知识库：五个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题，提供三种视觉风格、会话状态反馈、伙伴交互和可配置的动态环境效果。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.
description.zh: 技能中心：按区域浏览技能、从 zip 安装，并支持启用停用、卸载、回收站恢复与搜索。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.
description.zh: 提示词场景选择器：下拉选场景即自动开新会话并填充提示词（支持 {变量}），微调即可发送。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：归档、恢复、删除持久化会话，按工作区限制会话数量上限，并提供体积治理面板。

description.en: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏的版本控制工作台：改动按类型分组，支持单文件与多文件暂存，提交/拉取/推送均先预览再确认，失败时弹窗展示 Git 原始输出。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。把文档作为「通用附件」交给节点（无需声明）：文件启动前落到工作区，节点用 ${inputs.附件} 拿到换行拼接的绝对路径自行解析。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

description.en: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.
description.zh: 右侧栏的卡片画布知识库：笔记就是节点，模型通过九个工具读写、连线、移除。节点可以挂图片和文档，读节点时连同内容一起返回（Office 文件就地抽取文本），图片还能作为图像直接交给模型。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。
