description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it continue, and text typed meanwhile is sent along as a steering message; the pause never interrupts an in-flight API call and the model does not notice it.
description.zh: 在模型完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次请求之前暂停，输入框保持可用：裸回车或点按钮放行，草稿有字则随本次请求一并发出作为插话；不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、察觉不到暂停。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that have no text layer instead of writing an empty file, naming the OCR alternative instead. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33 天节假日、6 个调休上班日），表外的年份直接说不知道，不猜。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Peak-hour reminder: while DeepSeek charges peak rates it shows a banner at the top of the DSH Web UI every N minutes (default 5, range 1-120), adds one at each peak/valley switch, stays silent during valley hours, and keeps a sidebar row with the current state and a countdown to the next switch. Peak rules (Beijing time Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; weekends, Chinese public holidays and 调休 weekends are valley all day) are evaluated in the host and served over two no-auth routes, /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state and /config; settings live in settings.section and are stored in ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json.
description.zh: 峰时提醒：DeepSeek 走高峰计价时，每隔 N 分钟（默认 5，可设 1–120）在 DSH Web 界面顶部提醒一次「现在是峰时」，峰↔谷切换各提醒一条，谷时完全不打扰；侧边栏底部常驻一行显示当前峰/谷状态与下次切换倒计时。峰谷规则（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；周末、法定节假日与调休周末全天谷价）由宿主判定，经 /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state 与 /config 两个免鉴权路由供界面读取；开关与间隔在设置页一节里改，存到 ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json。

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one ordered delivery.
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

description.en: One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.
description.zh: 发送前把输入框草稿按所选角色卡的口吻改写，用当前会话正在使用的模型；可先审查再发送，并有一项本地检查会点名改写过程中丢掉的技术记号。

description.en: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place with `/role <id>`, adds the persona as its own prompt section after the deployment persona (it never overrides the host identity line) without touching tools or skills; roles are plain `ROLE.md` files and each switch is announced in the transcript.
description.zh: 用 `/role <id>` 就地切换当前会话的人设与说话风格，以独立的 prompt section 追加在部署人设之后（不替换宿主身份行），不动工具与技能；角色是角色库里的 `ROLE.md` 纯文本文件，切换后会在会话里声明一次。

description.en: Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics, per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a global font-size adjuster, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、外观全局字号、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux: 106 transparent animations in the browser overlay or a transparent always-on-top desktop window, throw-and-bounce drag physics with squash and particle scoring, a work-status bubble driven by live session events, self-talk and chat with persistent memory, balance display, meme-image bubbles, multiple pets on screen, and drop-in custom animations and pet packs.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端可用：浏览器浮层或透明置顶桌面窗口，106 个透明动画、带挤压与粒子的甩抛反弹物理、随会话事件实时联动的工作状态气泡、碎碎念与带持久记忆的对话、余额展示、表情包配图、多开同屏，并支持直接放入的自定义动画与宠物种类（pet pack）。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included patch adds live animation, bubble and meme sync. Requires dsh-pet 0.3.7.
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: four personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：四个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision service: `pip install phocinae-server`, then download the ~330 MB weights and keep the service running; without it the tool returns `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.
description.zh: 粘贴即编号引用：Ctrl+V 的截图入库后拿到固定编号「图片N」，在输入框旁面板里以缩略图列出，可经 @图片 菜单插入引用；开着「自动插入」时粘贴后直接落到光标处。

description.en: Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools and one-click install.
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.
description.zh: 把对话中划选的段落固定到按对话隔离的右侧栏面板，在正文里留下持久标记并可点击跳回原文；可从划选浮条或输入框 @ 把已固定的段落引用进消息，片段支持标签，面板可搜索、筛选并导出 Markdown 提纲。

description.en: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

description.en: E-commerce product image generation for DSH: 24 prompt modules covering main, detail and ad images, style transfer from a reference shot, batch runs, and a project gallery with live preview.
description.zh: DSH 电商商品图生成：24 个提示词模块覆盖主图、详情图与广告图，支持参考图风格复刻、批量生成，以及作品库实时预览。

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard) while planning, and a four-phase planning prompt section (explore, design, review, exit), reusing the official plan/mode state machine and exit review flow.
description.zh: dsh 计划模式的 ZCode 式增强：模型可主动调用 enter_plan_mode 进入计划模式，计划期间写类工具在分发前被硬拦截，并注入「探索 → 设计 → 评审 → 退出」四阶段工作流提示词；复用官方 plan/mode 状态机与退出评审流，只做增量。

description.en: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
description.zh: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Persistent Bots and group rooms inside DSH — each Bot keeps its own model, permission preset, workspace and session across restarts, and every answer is a run written to a ledger the sidebar panel replays.
description.zh: DSH 里的常驻 Bot 与群聊房间——每个 Bot 都有自己的模型、权限预设、工作区与重启后仍在的会话，每次回答都是一条写进运行记录的 run，侧栏面板据此回放。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.
description.zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: Settings section for archived sessions: browse by workspace, search, batch unarchive with the sidebar updating live, and optional auto-archive rules (idle days, keep-last-N per workspace) with a dry-run preview — plus a left-edge turn rail for jumping between turns of long conversations and ↑/↓ input history in the composer.
description.zh: 设置页的归档会话分区：按工作区分组浏览、搜索、批量取消归档，侧边栏实时恢复；自动归档规则（不活跃天数、每工作区保留条数）可选，执行前可试运行预览。另含长会话的左缘轮次刻度尺（悬停预览、点击跳转、Alt+↑/↓ 逐轮移动）与输入框 ↑/↓ 历史翻找。

description.en: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.
description.zh: 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: Plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness that delegates every version decision to the dsh CLI, so the pnpm release-age policy still decides what is eligible; it snapshots before applying, can roll back, keeps a lock list, and can check or auto-apply on a schedule the user turns on.
description.zh: DSH 插件更新器：把版本决策交给 dsh CLI，继续受 pnpm 发布年龄策略约束；应用前先快照、可回滚、带锁定清单，用户打开开关后可定时检查或自动应用。

description.en: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

description.en: Drive Blender 3D modeling from the harness — create primitives, run boolean CSG, transform, assign material and modifier, query the scene, and export STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF via a JSON bridge. Bundles a headless trimesh+manifold3d runtime and a Blender bpy add-on speaking the same protocol. Includes auto environment setup (detect/install/configure/verify via the blender_setup tool).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Blender 3D 建模——创建基本体、布尔运算、变换、赋予材质与修改器、查询场景，并通过 JSON 桥接导出 STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF。内置无头 trimesh+manifold3d 运行时，以及同协议的 Blender bpy 插件。内置自动环境检测/安装/配置/验证（blender_setup 工具）。

description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

description.en: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.
description.zh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.
description.zh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

description.en: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，把该套餐的模型作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 provider 路由提供；调用 api.openai.com/v1/responses 并使用账号的套餐授权范围，而非 Codex 后端。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Installs the coaligne-workflow skill for CoAligne team collaboration; requires CoAligne Desktop (signed in) to provide the MCP connection - not usable without Desktop.
description.zh: 安装 CoAligne 团队协作的 coaligne-workflow skill；MCP 连接由登录后的 CoAligne Desktop 提供，不安装 Desktop 则无法使用。

description.en: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
description.zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

description.en: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
description.zh: 对比已有 DSH 会话，或在两套 Agent Preset 之间运行受控 A/B 试验，展示对齐时间线、配对指标差值、显式验收结果与可导出的报告。

description.en: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件相对当前宿主的版本声明与 API 风险，报告可用源码位置、确定度、影响依据和覆盖限制。提供兼容性设置面板、插件详情发现与角标、compat_check 对话工具及 skill provider。

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
description.zh: 工具结果的预防式内容策略：改写命中文本，并按字段路径整段丢弃或截断，让未经审查的载荷在结果被规范化/渲染/落盘之前就进不去。随包为真空操作，不含任何内置的类别或域名黑名单。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.
description.zh: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

description.en: Runtime diagnostics for DSH plugins: live, restart, or hot reload.
description.zh: DSH 插件运行时诊断：区分实时生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置 web_search 加一个开关：在 DeepSeek Search API（/v1/tools/search）与默认账号搜索之间切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧栏开关。

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.
description.zh: 与桌面端或 dsh web 运行在同一个 Host 里的 Discord 桥接，无需单独进程或 profile：在私信或线程里与任意工作区的会话对话，接入桌面端正在用的会话，工具审批和模型提问在 Discord 与桌面端谁先答谁生效。

description.en: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
description.zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

description.en: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a running turn, and choosing per-chat permission modes (read-only, workspace, Auto Review, full). Long output paginates instead of being cut. Owner binding: the QR scan binds the scanner; with manually entered credentials the first sender claims ownership and everyone else is refused.
description.zh: 飞书 IM 通道：扫码创建专属飞书机器人；每轮结束推一张卡片，在飞书里授权工具调用、回答结构化提问，并直接用聊天驱动会话（/sessions 列会话、/resume 切换绑定会话、任务进行中可插话引导），还能按对话设置权限模式（只读 / 工作区读写 / Auto Review / 完全权限）。消息以卡片 JSON 2.0 发送，超长内容分页而不是截断。归属绑定：扫码创建时绑定扫码人；手填凭据时由首个发消息的人认领，其余人一律拒绝。

description.en: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

description.en: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

description.en: Windows-only. Trust a newly added workspace folder once, then grants the NTFS rights the workspace-write sandbox needs and pushes the grant plus the Low integrity label through folders that already exist; repairs show live progress.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：新增工作区时授权一次，补齐 workspace-write 沙箱所需的 NTFS 权限，并把授权与 Low 完整性标签铺进已有子目录；修复过程带实时进度与日志。

description.en: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
description.zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

description.en: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
description.zh: Code-first React + TypeScript 任务应用，支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏与 localhost；交互状态可供 Agent 后续轮次读取，MCP 和 API 访问在用户授权后执行。

description.en: Claude-style Git branch and PR composer bar for DeepSeek Harness: quick branch switcher, native diff drawer integration, and adaptive PR creation with Actions CI status.
description.zh: DSH 对话输入框 Git 状态胶囊条：极速切换分支、联动原生 Diff 抽屉、自适应 Commit/PR 及 Actions CI 状态追踪。

description.en: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Git 工作台：分支搜索与切换、hunk 级暂存、提交图谱、文件历史与 blame、储藏与工作树管理、冲突处理，以及 8 个供 agent 使用的 Git 工具。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. Beta.2 supports DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2, with Node.js >=24.
description.zh: 目标进展图以只读流程图展示目标到计划的进展路线、会话思维导图与步骤列表，按已报告计划计算进度，不启动任务或模型调用。Beta.2 支持 DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.2、Node.js >=24。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.
description.zh: 在 DSH「已安装插件」页新增「我的分组」标签页：自定义分组与拖拽排序、彩色文字标签、中文备注、分组锁定、真实启停开关，以及两个预设快照槽位。

description.en: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, installed, evaluated or run.
description.zh: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 动态点阵鲸鱼壁纸：约 1,750 个呼吸的 WebGL2 粒子，指针液态涡流交互，明暗双主题，带 Canvas2D 回退。

description.en: Multi-host compatibility matrix, official format-1 market index builder, and a read-only plugin_health tool for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: DSH 插件的多宿主兼容矩阵、官方 format-1 市场索引生成器，以及只读的 plugin_health 诊断工具。

description.en: Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.
description.zh: 定时心跳：用 followup 注入唤醒每个根 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点——忙碌时排队不打断、最多保留一条、连续无人回应自动暂停，用户下一条消息即恢复。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
description.zh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

description.en: Plugin index inside DSH that lists over 10,000 third-party plugins checked against the dsh.bundle manifest in their package.json rather than by star count, with one-click install and a companion website.
description.zh: DSH 内的插件索引，收录 1 万余个按 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle 声明校验过的第三方插件（不按星数判定），支持一键安装，另有配套网站。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
description.zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

description.en: Drag-and-drop reordering, official/third-party dividers and a stash panel for the buttons DSH renders in the sidebar, the sidebar footer, the conversation tabs, the composer dock and Settings. Only display position changes; the plugin registry is untouched.
description.zh: 对 DSH 投放到侧边栏顶部、侧边栏底部、对话标签、输入框停靠行与设置页导航的插件按钮做拖拽排序、官方/第三方分隔线与按钮收纳。只改变显示位置，不改动插件注册表。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with auto-discovery, quota windows, reset times, color-coded status, dragging, and automatic refresh.
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

description.en: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.
description.zh: 学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。

description.en: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.
description.zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

description.en: Browse and search GitHub dsh-plugin repositories from Web UI Settings, sort by stars, and install plugins through the DSH CLI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 设置页浏览和搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 仓库，按 Star 排序，并通过 DSH CLI 安装插件。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。

description.en: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.
description.zh: 把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）图形符号的 SVG，可选用 A4/A3 幅面自动分页。

description.en: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.
description.zh: 通过 UDP 组播或端口扫描发现局域网内的其他 DSH 实例，在侧栏面板中列出它们以及各自上报的能力，并可经局域网或自动下载的用户态 Tailscale 节点在两台机器之间双向派发任务。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API, which must be running. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-molio.
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and goal-mode alerts that wait for the final round.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its source so only a file path enters the context, and returns byte size, line count, token estimate and a heading outline, for a single file or a whole directory.
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. Analysis is upstream's: native binaries (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA), JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and adb devices, firmware, and process captures.
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served through the DSH skills registry with their scripts, references and cross-links intact (frontmatter folded into a manifest, prefixes realigned to DSH skill names). Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): the /superpowers slash command declares the producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.
description.zh: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with defect rework, acceptance — and gives the model 12 `teamflow_*` tools plus a workbench with a live pipeline graph and a backlog kanban. Each requirement gets its own folder holding the PRD, design, technical plan, QA report and acceptance record.
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
description.zh: 用 Android/iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 dsh 完整网页界面,经 iroh 跨网点对点打洞直连,不用架任何服务器;打不通才退回 relay,relay 只见密文。

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
description.zh: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

description.en: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

description.en: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
description.zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

description.en: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
description.zh: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

description.en: Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: one package carrying a corridor index, which detects the caller peer band and routes to the closed corridor card that matches it (0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 as legs A+B, 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2 as leg C), plus a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者的升级技能：一个包只放一份走廊索引，自动识别调用方的 peer 区间并路由到对应已封版的升级卡片（0.1.3-alpha.1 至 0.1.5-rc.1 为 A+B 两条腿，0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.1.6-alpha.2 为 C 腿），并附带以 bundle 技能与 npx CLI 两种形态提供的零依赖接缝扫描器。

description.en: Merged, version-locked plugin upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 as two closed legs): an evidence-bound version card plus a zero-dependency 20-seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 合并后的版本锁定插件升级技能（0.1.3-alpha.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1，两条闭环腿）：证据绑定版本卡 + 零依赖 20 接缝扫描器，以 bundle 技能 + npx CLI 两种形态发布。

description.en: Adds a Versions tab to the Plugins page: one-click upgrade of all upgradable plugins or a multi-selected subset, version history back to any published release, and GitHub links for each repo and each version.
description.zh: 在「插件」页新增版本页：一键升级全部可升级插件或勾选的子集，查看历史版本并回滚到任意已发布版本，并为每个插件和每个版本提供 GitHub 链接。

description.en: A usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a configurable per-million-token price table seeded with DeepSeek's prices, with reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；可配置的每百万 Token 价格表（内置 DeepSeek 常见模型价），参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
description.zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.
