description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件:把 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进简历库建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),新简历自动入库、重复自动去重;用大白话下指令即可筛选,硬性条件靠库内规则精准过滤,入围的少数人再由 LLM 精判适配度,结果可导出、可追溯。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.
description.zh: 撤回/编辑重发/重新生成，加上单会话版本化：每次回退的时间线、产物回退（git 优先、快照兜底）、分叉图、会话谱系，以及实时看门狗（并发写入第一时间快照日志）。编辑前自动停止运行中的 agent（官方 cancel/whenIdle），回退不会损坏持久化日志、也不会破坏 /compact。

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.
description.zh: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.
description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件 - 让手机/平板访问 DSH 获得完整功能，修复反代访问时设置面板无法打开的问题。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容寻址 blob 去重并自动 GC。深浅两套配色跟随 DSH 主题，字体跟随 DSH 与已装皮肤（也可选机器上的任意字体并微调字号）；设置里可把「用简体中文思考」规则注入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.
description.zh: 同一会话窗口内的 in-place 对话回退（不 fork，Claude Code /rewind 语义）：每条消息的 ↶ 按钮把模型上下文回退到任意用户消息，可选用磁盘持久化的 before-backups 还原工作区文件。

description.en: Expose control of dsh as MCP server and built-in dsh tools.
description.zh: 将控制 dsh 的能力暴露为 MCP 和内置工具。

description.en: Local dev panel for the DSH web GUI: follow service logs, start/stop workspace programs, debug Java over JDWP, browse and edit workspace files, and search file names. Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later; starting or debugging Java programs needs a local JDK and Maven, and starting front-end programs needs Node.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的本机开发面板：跟随服务日志、启停工作区程序、JDWP 调试 Java、浏览编辑工作区文件与文件名搜索。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高版本；启动或调试 Java 程序需要本机 JDK 与 Maven，启动前端程序需要 Node。

description.en: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
description.zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

description.en: Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.
description.zh: DSH 实时安全浮标，随工具调用更新防护状态，点击查看调用统计、风险来源链和拦截结果，支持只读任务约束及工具元数据变化检测。

description.en: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.
description.zh: 德州扑克 AI 陪练：双人对局、持久公开行为记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

description.en: Remote access to running DeepSeek Harness sessions from a phone browser: scan a one-time QR code to continue conversations, answer approvals and start new tasks over Wi-Fi or a tunnel.
description.zh: 远程连接正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：手机浏览器扫码即可继续对话、处理审批、新建任务，支持同一 Wi-Fi 或临时隧道。

description.en: Trip planning workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a map page with day-by-day stops, roam_* tools that draft, review and adopt an itinerary, and optional MCP sidecars for rail tickets and Xiaohongshu notes.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的行程工作台：地图页按天展示站点，roam_* 工具负责起草、审阅与采用行程，可选接入火车票和小红书笔记的 MCP 数据源。

description.en: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
description.zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

description.en: Observational file-mutation rollback for the fs tools: write/edit pre-images are checkpointed as git blobs or snapshots and restored through a model-facing rollback_files tool or a /rollback command.
description.zh: 文件变更回滚：捕获 write/edit 工具调用的改前映像（git blob 或快照），通过面向模型的 rollback_files 工具或 /rollback 命令还原。

description.en: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.
description.zh: dsh agent 树的递归委派：用预设与 Host 限制划定每个子 agent 的能力边界，子 agent 在各自 _agents/ 工作区独立工作，成果由父 agent 决定是否合并、如何合并。

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话轮次上点击右键弹出的圆盘菜单：从此轮分叉出新会话、打断生成、复制工作目录路径与会话 ID、打开工作目录、导出会话日志。

description.en: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的圆桌会议，复用已有 Agent 会话，提供讨论、可编辑任务卡、顺序与并行步骤、会议文件归档及秘书纪要。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动思考档位路由：本地微调的 7 题分类模型（ModernBERT，842MB，CPU 推理 <1s）对无档位指令的消息自动选择 low/high/max；会话内检测到重试自动沿阶梯升档，受「别用 max」类排除约束压制；判定服务不可达时熔断降级，会话不断。前端档位芯片实时显示当前档位与最近 20 轮判断原因。判定全程本地推理，任务文本不出本机。

description.en: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.
description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 云端通道作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh-router，提供模型列表与流式对话补全。

description.en: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 TRAE SOLO 供应商插件，移植自 traework2api。提供 traework 供应商这一免费 SOLO 聊天通道，并向 dsh-router 核心上报单账号状态。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: RSS/Atom digest bundle for dsh: subscribe to feeds, fetch on a schedule, dedupe exact and near-duplicate stories, and get LLM-summarized daily Markdown briefings delivered into conversations and/or files (with a standalone CLI).
description.zh: dsh 的 RSS/Atom 摘要插件:订阅源管理、定时抓取、精确与近似去重,并由 LLM 生成每日 Markdown 简报投递到会话和/或文件(同时提供独立 CLI)。

description.en: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件：多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时检查去重、新条目邮件通知（缩略图 HTML 模板），SMTP 密码走凭据库永不落盘，原生设置页四页签体验。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
description.zh: 在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
description.zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

description.en: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.
description.zh: 为回答里的命令行代码框加「运行」按钮，通过宿主 shell 服务执行该命令，输出显示在右下角浮动面板，或每个运行一个底部面板标签页。

description.en: Turns explicit DSH session experience into reviewable native Skill drafts that are saved only after user approval.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话中明确表达的经验整理为可审核的原生 Skill 草稿，并仅在用户确认后保存。

description.en: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
description.zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

description.en: Run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows from chat — settings card, sha256 media upload cache, concurrency gate, and background task ledger.
description.zh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

description.en: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中显示厂商标志，并让模型列表与提供方保持同步：把公开目录与标志镜像到本地回环地址，再依据路由自身的接口重新生成 pi-ai 路由的模型列表，写入之前先显示差异。

description.en: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
description.zh: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

description.en: Windows x64 CPU translation panel for text and original-format documents, using host model selection, voice input and document preview. CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. The download is about 364 MB.
description.zh: 翻译 CPU：Windows x64 文本与原格式文档翻译，复用宿主模型选择、语音输入及文档预览。使用 CPU OCR，不安装 NVIDIA 运行库。下载约 364 MB。

description.en: Windows x64 CUDA translation panel for text and original-format documents, using host model selection, voice input and document preview. Automatically installs its pinned CUDA/cuDNN component; falls back to CPU when no compatible GPU is available. The download is about 2.04 GB.
description.zh: 翻译 CUDA：Windows x64 文本与原格式文档翻译，复用宿主模型选择、语音输入及文档预览。自动安装绑定的 CUDA/cuDNN 组件，无兼容 GPU 时回退 CPU。下载约 2.04 GB。

description.en: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄时去掉这两个字段（只有 justification 时也会去掉）。同时兼容 GPT 从 Codex shell 工具带过来的取值：null、空值和 use_default 视为没有请求；会话已经是 danger-full-access 时，任何取值（包括 require_escalated）都会去掉，因为不存在更宽的模式。真正的升权请求、无法识别的模式值，以及没有声明 DSH 升权参数的工具，都原样交给 DSH 处理。不会放宽任何权限。监控的工具列表可配置（默认 bash、pwsh、write、edit、run_code）。零依赖。

description.en: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片上增加下载按钮，present 交付的文件可直接从浏览器下载。

description.en: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把整轮问答（问题 + 完整回答）存成工作区里的纯 Markdown；把值得留的提升进跨项目个人知识库，模型可按需检索。无数据库、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

description.en: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话、汇报内容，过长的汇报先压缩再念。角色声线不需要自己训练：一段 3-10 秒参考音就能克隆，也能直接用别人训练好的模型；不必为此装一整套 6.4 GB 的 GPT-SoVITS —— 运行时和声线都由插件自己装好。已有 GPT-SoVITS 的话也能直接接上，两者跑的是同一套声线。

description.en: Scans MCP servers configured in Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy and probes real connectivity via stdio and streamable-http initialize handshakes, with enable/disable toggles and a /mcp control panel.
description.zh: 扫描 Claude Code / Codex / CodeBuddy 配置中的 MCP，通过 stdio 与 streamable-http initialize 握手检测真实连通性，支持启停开关与 /mcp 控制面板。

description.en: OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs into Markdown, built around the fact that a book takes about an hour: every page is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes, a progress log reports live status, and a quality report names empty pages and low-confidence lines. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements; the first run downloads the OCR model.
description.zh: 把扫描版 PDF（影印书、拍照件）OCR 成 Markdown，并按“一本书要跑约一小时”来设计：逐页写检查点，中断可续跑；进度日志随时可查；质量报告点名空白页和低置信行。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements；首次运行会下载 OCR 模型。

description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

description.en: Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：按 Cron 表达式到点自动新建 DSH 会话并注入提示词执行，支持任务历史、手动运行与启停。也可直接调用 KNJ 工作流：支持直接选文件（持久化快照，每次触发重新交给流程）与按路径引用两种方式。侧边栏入口由 dsh-knj-menu 提供，一条命令安装：dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).
description.zh: 可复现科学分析工作台：agent 驱动的 cell、内联图形与反馈重画、manifest 溯源、环境快照与出版级出图技能（9 个 bio_* 工具 + 工作台界面）。

description.en: A biomedical Research Graph grounded in literature and experiment results. Fork hypotheses, connect evidence, advance research.
description.zh: 基于文献和实验结果的生物医学研究图谱，拆分假设，连接证据，推进研究。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

description.en: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so the workspace holds only real deliverables.
description.zh: 把操作腳本的寫入導出工作區、改放各 session 的暫存根，並把每一支收進工作區外的可檢視收納庫，讓工作區只留下真正的交付物。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.
description.zh: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Routes DSH web search and fetch through configured providers and records per-attempt usage and estimated costs. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 按已配置渠道路由 DSH 网页搜索与抓取，并记录每次尝试的用量和估算费用。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in place, and the composer summary lists, edits and jumps back to each annotation.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页版对话里划词，把选中文本作为批注附到下一条消息。原文位置保留虚线高亮和序号角标，输入框上方的批注摘要可查看、编辑并跳回每一条批注。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

description.en: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PATH; the first query on a repository builds its index.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI 完成，并附一个随包分发的路由技能。需要 PATH 中有 uv；对某个仓库的首次查询会建立索引。

description.en: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.
description.zh: 把商汤日日新（SenseNova）模型接入 dsh，并提供按 Key 轮换的 Key 池：粘贴任意多把 API Key，请求在多把 Key 之间轮转；遇 429 限流立即换下一把 Key 重试，每把 Key 独立指数退避冷却；本地 RPM 预限流从源头避开限流，池子耗尽时回报 503 与 Retry-After，使 429 不会传到调用方。内置可离线使用的模型目录并从 /v1/models 刷新，设置卡片提供脱敏 Key 列表、单把探活与删除。

description.en: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
description.zh: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

description.en: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per model) before the model reads them, and scrubs the outgoing request again before dispatch, so blocked characters cannot trip the official API Content Exists Risk 400.
description.zh: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
description.zh: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio. Both sides are direct HTTP retrievals with no auxiliary model turn: URL-deduped sources, long DeepSeek summaries clipped into snippets, per-backend timeouts and graceful degradation to whichever backend answers.
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

description.en: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the settings page before you start; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.
description.zh: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中增加「永久删除会话」的操作，并附带确认对话框：对话框会说明会话日志大小，以及与该会话绑定的进行中轮次、子代理、后台任务和提醒；删除后 id 会从 live、归档与工作区登记中一并释放，因此刷新列表时该行不会复活。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.
description.zh: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, or the working directory.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown 或工作目录。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.
description.zh: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

description.en: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方 Client 服务，自身不持有状态、不轮询，也没有宿主侧代码。

description.en: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
description.zh: 回溯式会话评估：从持久化日志生成确定性成绩卡与跨会话回归对比——不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

description.en: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.
description.zh: 会话证据报告：/transcript 从权威日志生成 HTML/Markdown/JSON 报告，/stats 输出终端统计卡，/archive 打包单会话 ZIP。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

description.en: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.
description.zh: 为网页侧边栏提供单层会话文件夹——按工作区分组会话，支持拖拽或右键菜单移动、归档与恢复，数据在服务端持久化。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是 ht719/dsh-session-categories 的维护分叉，已移植到当前 DSH 并新增置顶、归档分区与删除回收站；不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.
description.zh: DSH 会话与工作区管理——工作区：归档与显示。会话：跨工作区移动、预设迁移、删除；收藏、待回看、优先级、标签、备注。批量操作。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: folder tree, tags, notes, recycle bin. Folders, tags and notes live in a separate index; deleting a session moves its directory to the plugin recycle bin, and cutting across workspaces moves the file and rewrites its cwd.
description.zh: 像 Windows 资源管理器那样管理 DSH 的会话：目录树、标签、备注、回收站。文件夹、标签、备注存在独立索引里；删除会话会把其目录移入插件回收站，跨工作区剪切会移动会话文件并改写其 cwd。

description.en: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
description.zh: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

description.en: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.
description.zh: 确定性跨会话检索：`recall` 工具带显式范围控制地搜索历史会话日志。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
description.zh: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral theme with continuous local-time day/night scenes and a farmer who works while the displayed conversation is running. Architecture reference: xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme.
description.zh: 手绘山湖田园主题：按本地时间连续呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随当前展示对话的任务运行状态进出田间。插件架构参考 xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.
description.zh: 用一次性链接邀请别人加入同一段对话，不需要账号：最多 20 位访客一起讨论、一起问 AI，分享用的 fork 以只读权限运行，所有者可以随时移除访客或结束分享。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

description.en: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
description.zh: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。

description.en: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

description.en: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘\[ / ⌘]）。

description.en: Collapses the DSH sidebar panel list into a single group row, and its gear opens an edit mode to show, hide and drag-reorder two groups: sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧的面板列表折叠成一行分组头；点齿轮进入编辑态，对两组内容分别勾选显示/隐藏、拖动排序——侧栏扩展入口与会话顶部视图标签。

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

description.en: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

description.en: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边追问与划选注释，保留完整对话历史，将结论带回主线。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
description.zh: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

description.en: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
description.zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

description.en: Minimal theme for dsh that removes shadows, glass blur, and brand tinting while tightening radii, plus UI extras: sidebar archive tabs with type-to-filter, model and reasoning-effort controls under the composer, per-turn subagent topology cards, colored cache-hit and context meters, and per-turn duration.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的极简主题：去投影去毛玻璃、收紧圆角、中性化气泡与交互态；并附带一组界面增强——侧栏归档分页与实时筛选、与输入卡片对齐的模型/思考等级控件、按回合绘制的子代理委派图、按数值着色的缓存命中与上下文占用、以及每轮回答的耗时。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: Browse the skill library from a floating-ball panel: you choose the skill root yourself through a native directory chooser (defaults to ~/.dsh/skills, no path is shipped with the plugin), skills are grouped into first and second level categories, descriptions are read from each SKILL.md frontmatter, search filters by skill name, description or original text, and a card opens the full SKILL.md. Skills can be switched on and off per card, per category or for the whole library — the toggle rewrites disable-model-invocation in that SKILL.md and keeps a .bak-toggle backup, and disabled cards grey out until restored. A failure ledger separates automatic from manual entries and records skill successes and failures by listening to tools/result events, reusing an existing ledger file if one is found in the library and otherwise creating one under skill-master/references. The DSH settings page gains a floating-ball section that shows or hides the three balls and offers one-click restore of a ball dragged off-screen.
description.zh: 悬浮球面板直接浏览技能库：技能库位置由你自己指定（弹系统目录选择框，默认 ~/.dsh/skills，插件不含任何预设路径），技能按一级/二级分类归组，中文简介直接读各 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter，支持按技能名、简介或原文实时搜索，点卡片查看 SKILL.md 全文。技能可单个卡片、按分类或全库批量启停——启停即改写该 SKILL.md frontmatter 的 disable-model-invocation 并自动备份为 .bak-toggle，停用卡灰显带徽章、随时一键恢复。失效台账分「自动 / 人工」两栏显示，监听 tools/result 事件自动登记成功与失败；初始化时会先在技能库内搜索已有台账文件复用（约定路径 skill-master/references 优先），搜不到才创建。DSH 设置页新增「悬浮球导航」分区，可控制三个悬浮球的显隐，并提供「一键恢复悬浮球默认位置」，把拖出屏幕的球立即复位。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, inspect, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, plus a skill market with tracked source sync and one-click update-all.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中枢：基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表浏览、搜索、启停、查看、诊断并新建本地技能，附技能市场：来源快照跟踪、一键全量更新。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: Manages DSH skills and MCP servers from the web settings: skill cards with hot enable/disable, workspace scopes, groups, batch migration and drag-and-drop import, plus stdio/HTTP MCP CRUD with connection tests, secret redaction and the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中管理技能与 MCP 服务器：技能卡片热启停、工作区作用域、分组、批量迁移与拖拽导入，以及 stdio/HTTP MCP 增删改查、连接测试、密钥脱敏，并附带统一 dsh-panel 命令行。

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，带技能包机制。技能以带版本的包安装，升级时绝不覆盖你改过的文件，只跳过并如实报告。另自带 6 个基础技能、按「你遇到的问题」分组的面板，以及让模型在对话里直接读写技能库的工具。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; skills outside the expression can still be added by hand or force-disabled, and the bundled `tagging-skills` teaches the agent to derive a tag set from the machine it is running on.
description.zh: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

description.en: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
